jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.

With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.

This 100% onsite role, serves as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.

**Prospects, Tours & Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center & provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing & submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.

**Client Records & Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records for all funder & grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs & communicate with vendors in real time.

**Supply & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk

**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 - 35.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

  

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non-monetary compensation which may be included.*

jobs.company: Life Skills Training and Educational Programs - LifeSTEPS
jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a full-time, highly motivated **Resident Services Coordinator & After-School Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Formal Job Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time 34 hours per week (14 hours per week Director of Social Services/20 hours per week Program Coordinator)
* **Job location:** Oakland/Alameda, CA
* **Pay: $21.00 per hour (Program Coordinator), $28.35-$30.00 per hour (Director of Social Services)**

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

jobs.title: Senior Center Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Senior Center Program Coordinator**
=====================================

**Location:** San Francisco, California  
**Position Type:** Full-Time, On-Site  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, daytime hours  
**Local Travel:** Required within San Francisco

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking an energetic, community-focused **Senior Center Program Coordinator** to support programs that help older adults remain active, healthy, and connected. This position coordinates daily program activities, workshops, participant enrollment, community outreach, administrative functions, and services across multiple local sites.

The ideal candidate is bilingual, highly organized, comfortable working directly with seniors, and passionate about serving the community.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Coordinate daily senior center programs, activities, classes, and educational workshops.
* Assist with participant enrollment, referrals, and program documentation.
* Manage program schedules and coordinate staff coverage across service locations.
* Facilitate wellness workshops, educational classes, and outreach events.
* Build and maintain positive relationships with participants and community partners.
* Provide language assistance to participants with limited English proficiency.
* Coordinate partner meetings, take detailed notes, and track follow-up items.
* Maintain accurate participant records, operational documents, and program reports.
* Conduct site visits, program assessments, and community surveys.
* Collect donations and maintain accurate related financial records.
* Order, receive, organize, and track program supplies and inventory.
* Provide administrative assistance and serve as Staff on Duty when needed.
* Follow all organizational procedures, contractual requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Travel to additional program sites within San Francisco as required.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Bilingual fluency in one of the following:

  + English and Spanish
  + English and Chinese
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and database management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow detailed instructions and work independently.
* Ability to stand for extended periods and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds.
* Availability to travel between local program sites.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* At least one year of experience working directly with older adults or senior populations.
* At least one year of community outreach or public engagement experience.
* Diabetes Educator, Health Educator, or related certification is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of older adults while supporting engaging wellness programs, educational initiatives, and valuable community services.

jobs.company: Episcopal Community Services of San Francisco
jobs.title: Meals Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Episcopal Community Services (ECS), employees work with participants who may be experiencing homelessness, behavioral health conditions, substance use challenges, and other difficult life circumstances. While this work is meaningful and mission-driven, it can at times be stressful, demanding, or unpredictable. Employees are expected to exercise sound judgment, remain aware of their surroundings, follow established safety, communication, and de-escalation procedures, participate in all required trainings, and promptly report incidents, threats, injuries, or unsafe conditions, in accordance with ECS policies and procedures.

This position is a fully onsite, client-facing role that requires in-person interaction and direct service delivery to participants at ECS program locations. Due to the essential nature of the duties and the need for consistent in-person engagement with clients, remote work or work-from-home arrangements are not available for this position.

**SUMMARY OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Healthy Aging Program Coordinator will oversee the DAS-funded meal programs, currently serving over 6000 meals each month at three ECS sites; Canon Kip Senior Center, 1064/66 Mission, and The Granada Hotel.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for coordination of administrative and educational aspects of the DAS-funded meals program at three sites.
* Collect all daily meal recording data from all sites, assuring accurate and timely information.
* Provide accurate meal recording, assurance of proper lunch service protocols, and garner feedback from consumers.
* Facilitate the distribution and collection of the annual consumer survey at all sites.
* Work with Director of Healthy Aging and Director of CHEFs to identify and reduce areas of waste.
* Coordinate the collection of all monetary contributions at each site according to the program’s strict requirements.
* Support all sites with database entries of new intakes, annual assessment renewals, and quarterly recertifications.
* Assist third-party organizations to facilitate nutritional education sessions at three sites, selecting appropriate topics and collecting accurate attendance
* Act as a liaison between the ECS kitchen and individual site needs for optimal quality assurance.
* Ensure all required signage is posted at all sites.
* Attend staff and community meetings as needed.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* At least 1 year experience in program coordination, project management or a related field is required
* Some experience working with people experiencing homelessness is preferred
* Collaborative work style, demonstrating initiative and flexibility
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
* Computer and technology proficiency is required, with the ability to learn new applications quickly
* Commitment to ECS’s mission and to its organizational values
* Must be able to lift at least 10 pounds

**OTHER:**

Must secure annual TB test. Must be finger “imaged”. All offers are contingent on successful passing this background check. Will honor and abide by rules of confidentiality. Office space will be shared and will function as a group room when not in use as an office.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager to launch programs on time, surface the bottlenecks that put those launches at risk, and drive them to resolution. This role is ideal for a structured problem solver who can take ambiguous, cross-functional issues, turn them into clear workstreams, and hold action owners accountable until the work is closed.

The ideal candidate brings a consulting background — or equivalent experience solving diverse problems across many projects — with the executive communication skills to brief leadership and the working-level presence to operate across the organization. You will run a diverse set of initiatives in parallel, distill noise into the few issues that matter, and make sure business needs are met in a fast-moving supply chain environment.

 **What You'll Do**

* Program launch execution: Drive supply chain workstreams so programs launch on time. Identify critical-path bottlenecks across suppliers, internal teams, and sites, and stay on them until they are resolved
* Ambiguity to action: Take unstructured, cross-functional problems and distill them into scoped projects with owners, timelines, and success criteria. Follow up with action owners until issues are closed
* Executive communication: Own leadership communication on key issues, risks, and progress. Distill complex operational noise into clear, decision-ready updates for executives while remaining close to the working level
* Cross-functional problem solving: Partner with Procurement, Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and suppliers to diagnose root causes, align on trade-offs, and implement durable fixes
* Portfolio management: Run multiple initiatives in parallel without dropping business-critical work. Prioritize against launch dates, supply risk, and operational impact so business needs stay met
* Operating cadence: Stand up the forums, trackers, and escalation paths needed to keep launches and issue resolution moving. Surface trends early and drive continuous improvement
* Influence without authority: Build trust across functions and levels. Drive alignment and accountability in a matrixed environment where you may not own every resource

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in supply chain operations, program management, or a similarly structured, cross-functional problem-solving role
* Consulting background strongly preferred — experience solving diverse problems across multiple projects, with demonstrated executive communication
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous problems, structure them into functional workstreams, and drive action owners to resolution
* Track record of launching programs or delivering complex initiatives on time in a fast-paced operational environment
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including briefing executives and working effectively with all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage a diverse set of initiatives in parallel while keeping business needs, priorities, and stakeholders aligned
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills (issue trees, root cause analysis, 5-Why, data-driven recommendations)
* Comfort operating in a high-ambiguity, high-velocity manufacturing or supply chain environment
* Experience influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$144,800 - $288,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Lead, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about solving complex business problems, diving deep into data, driving process improvement, and leading change throughout an organization? Are you energized by putting emerging AI capabilities to work in how you operate every day? The AWS Strategic Accounts Business Operations team is seeking an experienced Sales Operations Lead to partner with our account management teams to define, land, and execute against our strategic priorities. You will partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to develop standard metrics that measure the productivity and success of programs, automate and optimize operational processes, and invent new ways of diving deep with data to uncover actionable insights. You will look around corners, measure the organization's performance, supply sales leadership with timely insights on the health of their business, and manage the operating cadence for the team.  
  
Strategic Accounts is one of AWS's most important and complex businesses — a portfolio of recognized industry leaders unlike any other segment. Working closely with senior sales leaders and executives, this role demands sharp judgment, precision, and executive-level communication: the ability to turn complexity into clear insight and to identify the true business signals that drive confident leadership decisions.  
  
The successful candidate has excellent business and sales acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, deep analytics experience, broad technical skills, and a demonstrated ability to both execute and influence. They are willing to roll up their sleeves, dive deep to learn, work comfortably within ambiguity, and have a passion for driving operational excellence.  
  
Above all, this role calls for someone who embodies Learn and Be Curious in the era of AI. Our business is evolving at the speed of AI, and so is how we work — we want a builder who is relentlessly curious about new AI capabilities (such as Amazon Quick), who invests the time to learn them deeply, and applies them to real problems to work faster and smarter. But curiosity goes beyond AI: it means getting to the bottom of complex business problems with many interdependencies, seeking the root cause rather than treating the symptom, and bringing a constant process-improvement mindset. The right person treats every new capability and hard problem as a chance to eliminate manual toil, surface insights earlier, and quantify the impact — in time saved or quality improved — while sharing what they learn and influencing others to adopt what works.  
  
In this role you will provide thought leadership for the organization. You will develop unique insights that drive dynamic decision making, set high standards, and use advanced technology to enable productivity. You will build strong relationships across the organization, tie insights to business strategy and results, and act as a proactive problem-solver who looks around corners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities for process or data improvement.  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and business where you'll have a high impact.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sales Operations Lead, your role is critical and highly visible across the organization. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  
Own revenue analysis and forecast accuracy for your accounts, surfacing the "why" behind weekly and monthly trends and variance drivers in partnership with Finance and ProServe.  
Drive measurable improvement in pipeline quality and hygiene, and use pipeline and revenue data to identify white space, resource optimization, and pipeline generation opportunities.  
Build and run the operating cadence for your account teams, including Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, elevating them toward forward-looking risks, opportunities, and leadership actions.  
Lead strategic and annual planning — territory planning, quota setting, goal setting, and account planning — and help teams turn plans into trackable, executable initiatives.  
Design and manage goals and metrics mechanisms that drive accountability, and curate qualitative customer insights into timely signals for leadership.  
Develop actionable, automated, self-service dashboards and reports.  
Drive process improvement and change management, leading and delivering training.  
Define tooling requirements and influence central teams' roadmaps to meet our high standards.  
Collaborate with other Operations leads to share and implement best practices.  
Lead adoption of AI tooling for operational use cases, quantifying the impact.  
Prepare ad hoc analysis and participate in projects as needed.  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about solving complex business problems, diving deep into data, driving process improvement, and leading change throughout an organization? Are you energized by putting emerging AI capabilities to work in how you operate every day? The AWS Strategic Accounts Business Operations team is seeking an experienced Sales Operations Lead to partner with our account management teams to define, land, and execute against our strategic priorities. You will partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to develop standard metrics that measure the productivity and success of programs, automate and optimize operational processes, and invent new ways of diving deep with data to uncover actionable insights. You will look around corners, measure the organization's performance, supply sales leadership with timely insights on the health of their business, and manage the operating cadence for the team.  
  
Strategic Accounts is one of AWS's most important and complex businesses — a portfolio of recognized industry leaders unlike any other segment. Working closely with senior sales leaders and executives, this role demands sharp judgment, precision, and executive-level communication: the ability to turn complexity into clear insight and to identify the true business signals that drive confident leadership decisions.  
  
The successful candidate has excellent business and sales acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, deep analytics experience, broad technical skills, and a demonstrated ability to both execute and influence. They are willing to roll up their sleeves, dive deep to learn, work comfortably within ambiguity, and have a passion for driving operational excellence.  
  
Above all, this role calls for someone who embodies Learn and Be Curious in the era of AI. Our business is evolving at the speed of AI, and so is how we work — we want a builder who is relentlessly curious about new AI capabilities (such as Amazon Quick), who invests the time to learn them deeply, and applies them to real problems to work faster and smarter. But curiosity goes beyond AI: it means getting to the bottom of complex business problems with many interdependencies, seeking the root cause rather than treating the symptom, and bringing a constant process-improvement mindset. The right person treats every new capability and hard problem as a chance to eliminate manual toil, surface insights earlier, and quantify the impact — in time saved or quality improved — while sharing what they learn and influencing others to adopt what works.  
  
In this role you will provide thought leadership for the organization. You will develop unique insights that drive dynamic decision making, set high standards, and use advanced technology to enable productivity. You will build strong relationships across the organization, tie insights to business strategy and results, and act as a proactive problem-solver who looks around corners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities for process or data improvement.  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and business where you'll have a high impact.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sales Operations Lead, your role is critical and highly visible across the organization. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  
Own revenue analysis and forecast accuracy for your accounts, surfacing the "why" behind weekly and monthly trends and variance drivers in partnership with Finance and ProServe.  
Drive measurable improvement in pipeline quality and hygiene, and use pipeline and revenue data to identify white space, resource optimization, and pipeline generation opportunities.  
Build and run the operating cadence for your account teams, including Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, elevating them toward forward-looking risks, opportunities, and leadership actions.  
Lead strategic and annual planning — territory planning, quota setting, goal setting, and account planning — and help teams turn plans into trackable, executable initiatives.  
Design and manage goals and metrics mechanisms that drive accountability, and curate qualitative customer insights into timely signals for leadership.  
Develop actionable, automated, self-service dashboards and reports.  
Drive process improvement and change management, leading and delivering training.  
Define tooling requirements and influence central teams' roadmaps to meet our high standards.  
Collaborate with other Operations leads to share and implement best practices.  
Lead adoption of AI tooling for operational use cases, quantifying the impact.  
Prepare ad hoc analysis and participate in projects as needed.

About AWS

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

A Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with AWS high-value strategic customer. Key aspects of the role include:  
  

* Relationship Management: Building deep, multi-threaded executive relationships, serving as the primary point of accountability for the overall account.

  

* Strategic Account Planning: creating and executing long-term account strategy that span quarters (not weeks), aligning cross-functional resources e.g. sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership.

  

* Revenue Expansion: owning revenue growth and identifying growth opportunities proactively, often before the customer realizes the need.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a strategic account and owning the overall account strategy, relationship health, and long-term growth trajectory  
  
Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align AWS services and solutions with customer business objectives, driving adoption across compute, storage, database, analytics, AI/ML, and generative AI workloads  
  
Build and maintain deep, multi-threaded executive relationships across all levels of the customer organization  
  
Drive revenue growth by identifying expansion opportunities, accelerating new workload migrations, and positioning AWS as the preferred cloud platform across the customer's global operations  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS specialist teams, solutions architects, partner managers, professional services, and executive leadership to deliver tailored solutions that address complex customer needs  
  
Lead strategic negotiations for large-scale enterprise agreements, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and Marketplace procurement strategies

California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

The Regional Supervisor – Operations & Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400+ Fellow, 100+ Host Partner Fellowship.

On the operations side, this position will own high-volume, detail-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability

* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
  + Program or operations administration
  + Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
  + Compliance, reporting, or audit support
  + Onboarding or human resources support
  + Stakeholder or partnership coordination
  + Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast-moving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing program needs and priorities

* Serve as a trusted, approachable point of contact for employees, handling complex personal or professional inquiries with total confidentiality.
* Manage sensitive employee relations and conflict resolution with fairness, discretion, and deep emotional intelligence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience**: 8–12+ years of progressive experience in People Operations or Human Resources, with at least 4+ years of direct people management experience.
* **Scaling & Growth**: Proven track record of building, scaling, and managing People Operations functions through rapid hyper-growth phases.
* **Autonomy & Drive**: Proven ability to translate broad business goals into actionable project roadmaps and execute independently with minimal direction.
* **Total Rewards Strategy**: Strategic expertise in Total Rewards and benefits design, vendor negotiations, and overseeing end-to-end Open Enrollment strategy.
* **Problem Solving & Discretion**: Demonstrated mastery in handling complex employee relations, internal investigations, and sensitive organizational challenges with exceptional emotional intelligence, discretion, and high integrity.

* **Communication Skills**: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with a natural approachability and warmth.

**Nice-to-have Skills**
-----------------------

* **Legal Compliance**: Deep knowledge of multi-state federal, state, and local employment laws, compliance frameworks, and complex HR governance.
* **Aerospace Regulations**: Familiarity with ITAR/EAR regulatory compliance and security clearances and its implications on talent acquisition, onboarding, and export control workflows.

**Salary**
----------

The salary range for this role is $193,000 - $214,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

**About Muon Space**
--------------------

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

**Taking Care of Our Team**
---------------------------

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Construction Project Manager is a junior, field-based role that supports a Construction Project Manager across their portfolio of active ADU and residential builds. This person is the PM’s eyes and ears in the field - visiting job sites, documenting progress, and handling the coordination and follow-up that keeps projects moving. It is a developmental position built for someone young, ambitious, and technically curious who wants to learn the PM role from the ground up and grow into managing their own portfolio within roughly 12–18 months.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Serve as the PM’s eyes and ears in the field** — conduct site visits across the PM’s active projects to observe progress, quality, and site conditions, and report back clearly.
* **Document everything** — capture daily logs, progress photos, and written field notes in Buildertrend so every project has an accurate, current record.
* Track subcontractor attendance and progress against the schedule; flag no-shows, delays, and slipping milestones to the PM immediately.
* Help coordinate subcontractor trades, material deliveries, and inspection scheduling under the PM’s direction.
* Confirm client-selected materials and finishes have arrived on site and match the project scope.
* Prepare job sites for inspections — verify access, cleanliness, and that required work is complete and ready.
* Follow up on punch-list and correction items, and confirm completion back to the PM.
* Run materials, documents, and equipment between job sites, suppliers, and the office as needed.
* Communicate professionally with homeowners on routine field matters; escalate anything sensitive or contractual to the PM.
* Learn IMKAT’s construction process, sequencing, and standards — take on increasing responsibility as skills develop.

**Experience**

* 2 years in construction, the trades, or a related field role - internships, labor, or trade experience all count.
* Exposure to residential construction job sites preferred, but a strong learner with the right drive will be considered.

**Technical Aptitude**

* Comfortable using a smartphone and software for documentation, photos, and communication; quick to pick up new tools like Buildertrend.

Pay: $29.00 - $33.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: On the road

**About the job**
-----------------

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's various product ecosystem. Additionally, we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).
  
  
gUP Platforms and Devices Google Store sits at the intersection of global e-commerce, hardware logistics, telecom, and generative AI. Our Product Support Managers architect automated systems, shape commercial and fraud policies, and power flagship Made by Google hardware across 20+ markets.  
  
In this role, you will own end-to-end customer journeys, driving AI self-service transformation, repairs modernization, and automated risk workflows. You will care deeply about data-driven root-cause elimination, reducing Repeat Contact Rates and resolution times by collaborating as embedded partners with Store, Fi, Engineering, Logistics, and Fraud teams.  
  
As a Product Support Manager, you will lead high-impact strategic initiatives shaping commerce and customer care across Google’s hardware and subscriptions portfolio. You will operate as a strategic bridge between gTech, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations, drive cross-functional programs spanning AI support transformation, journey innovation, and product launches. You will combine deep business acumen, data-driven strategy, and stakeholder influence to solve complex challenges at global scale, enhancing satisfaction, driving revenue, and transforming operational efficiency.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Synthesize quantitative metrics and customer intelligence into executive business cases, influencing upstream product features, policies, and e-commerce roadmaps.

jobs.title: Program Manager, AI and Gemini App Marketing
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Program Management certification or experience in program management with a technology company.
* 3 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Direct experience building or managing AI-agentic workflows (e.g., orchestrating multiple AI agents to complete complex, multi-step tasks).
* Experience in stakeholder management.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Program Manager for the AI and Gemini App Marketing team, you will be a key member of the Program Management team that acts as the operational engine connecting product and marketing strategy to seamless execution. In this role, your main objective is to equip marketers with the tools and processes to move with greater agility and velocity so together, you can seamlessly land launches and an ongoing drumbeat of marketing activity across Google’s top AI priorities. If you thrive in ambiguity, love building operational infrastructure (often from scratch), and want to shape how Google launches AI, this is your team.

You will support critical programs, including model go-to-market and tentpole moment enablement. Your role is truly cross-functional you will partner closely with Marketing leadership and connect the dots across PR, Product Areas like Chrome and Android, and Regions to bring our GTM strategy to life.

To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate possesses a track record in program management. You will support critical programs and short-term sprints, enabling rapid progress in a highly complex space. You are analytical and entrepreneurial, willing to try new things while managing numerous high-stakes projects with tight deadlines. You have a passion for AI and use AI tools to be more productive, saving time and enabling velocity. Things happen quickly at Google, and to do great work, you need to rapidly learn new context; quickly develop relationships across Marketing, Product, Comms and beyond; and produce meaningful results in highly ambiguous environments.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support end-to-end program management across critical cross-marketing initiatives, starting with early access/influencers, red teaming, and GTM enablement programs.
* Support multiple workstreams within a cross-functional program, proactively identifying, tracking, and mitigating risks.
* Act as the vanguard for the team’s AI transformation, transitioning manual, fragmented templates, tools and processes into automated, real-time ones.
* Act as a strategic bridge and escalation point across Product, Marketing, Legal, Comms, and Regional teams to eliminate silos.

jobs.title: Richmond- ASP Program Leader
jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),

o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or

o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

***After School Program Dates***

* *San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027*

**Job Responsibilities**  
**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.

* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.

* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.

**Supervision & Safety**  
Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.  
Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline

**Record-Keeping & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation

**Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.

**Training & Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**  
The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

  

**The YMCA of Greater San Francisco is seeking Program Leaders at the following sites:**

* Richmond- Claire Lilienthal Elementary School
* Richmond- Jefferson Elementary School
* Richmond- Sutro Elementary School

* A problem solver with a solution focused mindset

jobs.title: Receptionist / Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview** Dr. Alexander Ereso is a leading cosmetic plastic surgeon serving patients throughout the greater San Francisco Bay Area. Our practice emphasizes a confidential, long-term partnership between patient and surgeon, with highly personalized aesthetic care tailored to each individual’s goals. All surgical procedures are performed in a private, modern, fully accredited ambulatory surgical facility. Supported by an experienced and elite clinical team, the practice is dedicated to exceptional patient safety, comfort, and natural-looking results. Team members join a professional environment focused on high-quality care and a respectful, collaborative culture.

**Job Summary** This is a part-time position, with the ability to flex additional hours based on office operational needs. We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and detail-oriented Experience and Patient Coordinator to join our elite team. In this hybrid role, you will serve as the primary touchpoint for our patients, combining high-touch luxury hospitality, seamless patient journey management, and proactive consultation coordination. You will guide patients from initial inquiry through their surgical and non-surgical journeys, ensuring an exceptional, white-glove experience while driving communication, scheduling, and conversion support.

**Duties**

* Manage inbound digital inquiries, phone calls, and social media leads with a prompt, calm, consultative approach in alignment with practice speed-to-lead standards.
* Conduct thorough patient consultations and pre-frame the patient journey to build emotional rapport, trust, and alignment with doctor recommendations.
* Coordinate patient schedules, streamline touchpoints from initial inquiry to post-operative follow-up, and handle booking logistics seamlessly.
* Guide patients through financial commitments, answer administrative questions with high emotional intelligence, and assist in addressing patient hesitations or objections ethically and effectively.
* Accompany doctors during clinical consultations when required to capture accurate, detailed notes and ensure a frictionless transition into the patient care pipeline.
* Maintain a pristine, organized, and luxury-standard front office and client environment, executing scheduled sensory and hospitality protocols.
* Partner cross-functional teams to support integrated marketing initiatives, social media engagement, content capture, and patient acquisition strategies.

**Requirements**

* Proven professional experience in luxury hospitality, premium retail, concierge medical environments, or aesthetic practice patient coordination.
* Exceptional customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills with a track record of building patient trust and driving conversion/retention.
* High emotional intelligence and strong problem-solving abilities to guide patients through medical and cosmetic decisions with empathy.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment while managing schedules, notes, and digital workflows.
* Collaborative mindset, willingness to cross-train across front office roles, and adaptability to practice-specific technology systems.

Join our team to deliver exceptional aesthetic care and high-touch service that enhances our clients’ confidence while advancing your career in a vibrant, beauty-focused environment!

Pay: $22.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4.0 – 16.0 per week

Benefits:

* Free flu shots
* On-the-job training
* Opportunities for advancement

Ability to Commute:

* Mountain View, CA 94040 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Bilingual Patient Experience & Treatment Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you someone who can make a complicated decision feel clear, comfortable, and manageable?

Sequoia Orthodontics is looking for a bilingual coordinator to guide patients and families from their initial consultation through financial arrangements, scheduling, and the start of treatment. You will work closely with the orthodontist and the rest of our team, combining patient relationships, organization, and practical problem-solving in a friendly, privately owned practice.

You do not need previous orthodontic experience to apply. Dental, healthcare, treatment-coordination, customer-service, hospitality, or patient-facing experience is helpful, but we are willing to train the right person. What matters most is that you communicate well, follow through, enjoy working with families, and are comfortable discussing schedules and financial options.

Professional fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

**What You’ll Do**

* Welcome patients and families and help them feel comfortable in our office
* Participate in new-patient consultations and help families understand their next steps
* Explain fees, insurance benefits, payment plans, and financial arrangements clearly
* Schedule treatment starts and coordinate the transition from consultation to active treatment
* Follow up with families who are considering treatment
* Verify insurance benefits and assist with insurance-related questions
* Collect payments and maintain accurate patient and financial information
* Coordinate appointments and assist with incoming calls and patient questions
* Communicate confidently with patients and parents in both Spanish and English
* Work closely with the orthodontist, clinical team, and front-office team
* Occasionally assist with patient events, community outreach, and practice-growth projects
* Help maintain an organized, upbeat, and welcoming office

**What We’re Looking For**

* Professional fluency in Spanish and English
* A warm, friendly, and confident communication style
* Comfort speaking with both children and adults
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
* The ability to explain financial information in a clear and approachable way
* Reliability and the ability to manage several priorities in a busy office
* A collaborative attitude and genuine interest in helping patients
* Comfort learning new systems, workflows, and insurance processes

Experience in orthodontics, dentistry, healthcare, treatment coordination, scheduling, insurance, or patient-facing service is a plus, but it is not required.

If you think you would be a strong fit but do not check every box, we still encourage you to apply.

**What We Offer**

* $35–$40 per hour, depending on experience
* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k)
* Flexible Spending Account
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Employee orthodontic benefits
* Continuing education and on-the-job training
* Performance bonus opportunities
* A supportive team in a privately owned practice
* A friendly, patient-focused work environment

**Position Details**

* Full-time
* Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
* In-person position in San Mateo, California

If you are bilingual, enjoy helping people, and would like to grow with a close-knit orthodontic team, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: $35.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Uniform allowance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Patient Services Rep I
jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Medicine Partners job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management. The PSR I is an entry-level position with limited or no prior experience; under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team. For situations where the PSR is designated as a "trainee," the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Medicine Partners
  
  
**What you will do**

* C-I-CARE
* Executes world class practices of service and patient care in support of C-I-CARE standards.
* Uses C-I-CARE templates and the following components for all communication with patients and staff:
* CONNECT with people by calling them their proper name, or the name they prefer (Mr., Ms., Dr.)
* INTRODUCE yourself and your role
* COMMUNICATE what you are going to do, how long it will take, and how it will impact the patient
* ASK permission before entering a room, examining a patient or undertaking an activity
* RESPOND to patient’s questions or requests promptly; anticipate patient needs
* EXIT courteously with an explanation of what will come next
* Job Scope
* Performs routine support work and in a learning capacity, assists in but not limited to the following:
* Greets patients and others entering the department in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Registers new patients, schedule appointments and updates existing patient accounts in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Identifies accepted insurance plans and those requiring referrals, obtains and updates insurance information if necessary.
* Determines if patient has a co-payment or deposit; accepts and records receipt of payment; provides applicable waiver and obtains appropriate signature; and, when appropriate, scans copy of patient’s photo ID, insurance card, and/or waiver.
* Obtains applicable consent from patient.
* Resolves any system red flags as they are encountered.
* Responds to requests from patients, family members, physicians and staff in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Facilities communication between the patients and the physicians or clinic.
* Delivers basic knowledge regarding clinic-specific processes.
* Accurately documents and routes calls to the appropriate department(s).
* Manages flow of information received from various sources to appropriate staff member. May handle and deliver requests for approvals requiring signatures or input, lab reports, correspondence, dictations, and medical records.
* Communicates with clinical staff/providers through telephone encounters.
* Resolves registration discrepancies via assigned work queues.
* Balances cash sheet and cash drawer, completes daily deposit summary and prepares monthly deposit summary in accordance with performance standards.
* Delivers consistent high-level of customer service by using CI-Care principles.
* Meets all regulatory and compliance standards.
* Knowledge
* Learns to apply general knowledge through work assignments.
* Level of Supervision
* Works under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team.
* For situations where the PSR is designated as a “trainee,” the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
* All other duties as assigned including department-specific functions and responsibilities:
* Performs other duties as assigned and participates in organization projects as assigned.
* Adheres to safety, P4P’s (if applicable), HIPAA and compliance policies.

  
**Education Qualifications**

* High school graduate or equivalent required.

  
**Experience Qualifications**

* One (1) year of customer service experience in a medical office, insurance, or client services environment required.
* Graduate of a Medical Receptionist training program, healthcare experience, or related preferred.
* EPIC experience preferred.

  
**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong verbal/written communication and listening skills; including excellent interpersonal skills and telephone communication.
* Ability to maintain composure during challenging interpersonal interactions.
* Legible handwriting.
* Basic math skills necessary to collect payments and balance cash drawer.
* Basic computer skills to include keyboarding, mouse movement and data entry skills to enter information into practice management system and EHR.
* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize tasks in order to complete assignments within the time allotted and maintain standard workflow.
* Ability to work with others in a flexible, cooperative manner.

  
**Physical Demands and Work Conditions**  
  
**Physical Demands**

* Constant Sitting.
* Occasional Walking.
* Occasional Standing.
* Frequent Bending.
* Occasional Squatting.
* Seldom Climbing.
* Occasional Kneeling.
* Seldom Crawling.
* Frequent Hand Use.
* Frequent Repetitive Motion Hand Use.
* Occasional Grasping.
* Occasional Fine Manipulation.
* Frequent Pushing and Pulling.
* Occasional Reaching (above shoulder level).
* Frequent Twisting and Turning (Neck and Waist).
* Constant Vision (Color, Peripheral, Distance, Focus).

**Lifting**

* Frequent lifting of 0 - 10 lbs.
* Frequent lifting of 11 - 20 lbs.
* Occasional lifting of 21 - 30 lbs.
* Occasional lifting of 31 - 40 l

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Medicine Partners job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management. The PSR I is an entry-level position with limited or no prior experience; under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team. For situations where the PSR is designated as a "trainee," the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Medicine Partners
  
  
**What you will do**

* C-I-CARE
* Executes world class practices of service and patient care in support of C-I-CARE standards.
* Uses C-I-CARE templates and the following components for all communication with patients and staff:
* CONNECT with people by calling them their proper name, or the name they prefer (Mr., Ms., Dr.)
* INTRODUCE yourself and your role
* COMMUNICATE what you are going to do, how long it will take, and how it will impact the patient
* ASK permission before entering a room, examining a patient or undertaking an activity
* RESPOND to patient’s questions or requests promptly; anticipate patient needs
* EXIT courteously with an explanation of what will come next
* Job Scope
* Performs routine support work and in a learning capacity, assists in but not limited to the following:
* Greets patients and others entering the department in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Registers new patients, schedule appointments and updates existing patient accounts in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Identifies accepted insurance plans and those requiring referrals, obtains and updates insurance information if necessary.
* Determines if patient has a co-payment or deposit; accepts and records receipt of payment; provides applicable waiver and obtains appropriate signature; and, when appropriate, scans copy of patient’s photo ID, insurance card, and/or waiver.
* Obtains applicable consent from patient.
* Resolves any system red flags as they are encountered.
* Responds to requests from patients, family members, physicians and staff in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Facilities communication between the patients and the physicians or clinic.
* Delivers basic knowledge regarding clinic-specific processes.
* Accurately documents and routes calls to the appropriate department(s).
* Manages flow of information received from various sources to appropriate staff member. May handle and deliver requests for approvals requiring signatures or input, lab reports, correspondence, dictations, and medical records.
* Communicates with clinical staff/providers through telephone encounters.
* Resolves registration discrepancies via assigned work queues.
* Balances cash sheet and cash drawer, completes daily deposit summary and prepares monthly deposit summary in accordance with performance standards.
* Delivers consistent high-level of customer service by using CI-Care principles.
* Meets all regulatory and compliance standards.
* Knowledge
* Learns to apply general knowledge through work assignments.
* Level of Supervision
* Works under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team.
* For situations where the PSR is designated as a “trainee,” the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
* All other duties as assigned including department-specific functions and responsibilities:
* Performs other duties as assigned and participates in organization projects as assigned.
* Adheres to safety, P4P’s (if applicable), HIPAA and compliance policies.

  
**Education Qualifications**

* High school graduate or equivalent required.

  
**Experience Qualifications**

* One (1) year of customer service experience in a medical office, insurance, or client services environment required.
* Graduate of a Medical Receptionist training program, healthcare experience, or related preferred.
* EPIC experience preferred.

  
**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong verbal/written communication and listening skills; including excellent interpersonal skills and telephone communication.
* Ability to maintain composure during challenging interpersonal interactions.
* Legible handwriting.
* Basic math skills necessary to collect payments and balance cash drawer.
* Basic computer skills to include keyboarding, mouse movement and data entry skills to enter information into practice management system and EHR.
* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize tasks in order to complete assignments within the time allotted and maintain standard workflow.
* Ability to work with others in a flexible, cooperative manner.

  
**Physical Demands and Work Conditions**  
  
**Physical Demands**

* Constant Sitting.
* Occasional Walking.
* Occasional Standing.
* Frequent Bending.
* Occasional Squatting.
* Seldom Climbing.
* Occasional Kneeling.
* Seldom Crawling.
* Frequent Hand Use.

* Occasional Grasping.
* Occasional Fine Manipulation.
* Frequent Pushing and Pulling.
* Occasional Reaching (above shoulder level).
* Frequent Twisting and Turning (Neck and Waist).
* Constant Vision (Color, Peripheral, Distance, Focus).

**Lifting**
