jobs.description:
**ABOUT MARINHEALTH**  
Are you looking for a place where you are empowered to bring innovation to reality? Join MarinHealth, an integrated, independent healthcare system with deep roots throughout the North Bay. With a world-class physician and clinical team, an affiliation with UCSF Health, an ever-expanding network of clinics, and a new state-of-the-art hospital, MarinHealth is growing quickly. MarinHealth comprises MarinHealth Medical Center, a 327-bed hospital in Greenbrae, and 55 primary care and specialty clinics in Marin, Sonoma, and Napa Counties. We attract healthcare’s most talented trailblazers who appreciate having the best of both worlds: the pioneering medicine of an academic medical center combined with an independent hospital's personalized, caring touch.

MarinHealth is already realizing the benefits of impressive growth and has consistently earned high praise and accolades, including being Named One of the Top 250 Hospitals Nationwide by Healthgrades, receiving a 5-star Ranking for Overall Hospital Quality from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and being named the Best Hospital in San Francisco/Marin by Bay Area Parent, among others.

**Company:**

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network

**Work Shift:**

Day Shift (United States of America)

**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

40

**Job Description Summary:**

The Sterile Processing Educator and Trainer oversees all aspects of sterile processing operations within the Medical Network. This critical role ensures the effective cleaning, sterilization, and distribution of medical instruments while upholding strict compliance with regulatory standards and infection control protocols.  
  
The role involves managing day-to-day operations, building and maintaining vendor relationships for surgical instrument procurement, and creating comprehensive training programs for sterile processing staff. Additionally, responsibilities include leading quality control efforts, ensuring adherence to compliance requirements, and promoting a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

**Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:**

Pay Range:

$33.25 - $39.50 - $44.71

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------------------

**Sterile Processing Management:**
----------------------------------

* Oversee the daily operations of the sterile processing areas across the Network, ensuring compliance with infection control standards, regulatory guidelines, and safety protocols.
* Monitor and maintain the cleanliness, functionality, and availability of medical instruments, ensuring proper sterilization techniques are consistently followed.
* Ensure proper tracking and inventory of all sterilized equipment, tools, and supplies.

**Vendor Management & Instrumentation Procurement:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with external vendors to manage the procurement of high-quality surgical instruments and equipment.
* Coordinate the ordering, delivery, and inventory management of instruments and sterilization supplies, ensuring that SPD needs are met in a timely manner.
* Evaluate vendor performance regularly, negotiating pricing and contract terms to ensure cost-efficiency without compromising on quality or safety standards.

**Staff Training & Development:**

* Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evaluation of sterile processing staff training programs, ensuring all team members are well-versed in sterile techniques, equipment handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations and provide guidance to SPD staff on best practices in sterilization procedures and safety protocols.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement by facilitating regular in-service training sessions and ensuring team members are up-to-date on the latest industry standards and innovations.

**Quality Control & Compliance:**

* Oversee routine quality control checks on sterilization processes and equipment, ensuring all procedures are in compliance with healthcare regulations.
* Work closely with the infection control team to monitor for any potential risks and take corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure adherence to accreditation and certification standards related to sterilization practices.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Proven experience in sterile processing and instrument management
* Strong knowledge of infection control procedures, sterilization methods, and healthcare regulations.
* Experience in vendor management and contract negotiations for medical instrumentation procurement.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a focus on team development and training.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Qualifications:**

**Education:**

* High school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) certificate required.
* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Management, Nursing, or a related field (preferred).

**Licenses/Certifications:**

* Certification in Sterile Processing (CRCST, CIS, or similar) is required.
* BLS Certification (American Heart Association) required.

**Experience:**

* A minimum of three years related experience required.
* Re-processing/ procedural experience required.
* Proven experience in sterile processing and instrument management
* Strong knowledge of infection control procedures, sterilization methods, and healthcare regulations.
* Experience in vendor management and contract negotiations for medical instrumentation procurement.
* Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a focus on team development and training.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Accommodation:**

Qualified applicants with disabilities may request reasonable accommodation during the application process by contacting Human Resources at 415-925-7040 or TalentAcquisition@mymarinhealth.org.

**C.A.R.E.S. Standards:**

MarinHealth seeks candidates ready to model our C.A.R.E.S.

jobs.title: Operations Associate (Pharmacy)
jobs.description:
Healthcare is broken at the first step: patients can't find the right care, understand what it costs, or access the medications they need. Mochi Health is fixing this.

We're building an AI-driven marketplace that makes healthcare discoverable—connecting patients to the right providers, transparent pharmacy pricing, and affordable medications. Over the past few years, we've grown rapidly by combining clinical expertise with technology that actually works for real people, not just hospital systems.

Our platform does what legacy healthcare can't: it gives patients transparent pricing before they pay, personalized medication management that follows them across providers, and long-term access to their own medical records. We're proving that healthcare can be more affordable, more human, and far more intuitive than what exists today.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Health, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're looking for independently driven and detail-oriented individuals to join our Pharmacy Operations team. In this role, you'll sit at the center of how medications move from prescription to a patient's doorstep, keeping fulfillment accurate, fast, and reliable. You'll partner closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical, Care, Product, and Data teams to optimize dispensing workflows, strengthen pharmacy partner relationships, and use data to continuously improve the patient experience.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Optimize pharmacy fulfillment workflows by identifying inefficiencies, implementing solutions, and continuously improving the path from prescription to delivery.
* Monitor and resolve fulfillment exceptions, including delayed, rejected, or stuck orders, prior authorization holds, and inventory or stock issues, so patients receive their medications on time.
* Analyze operational data using SQL and other tools to track pharmacy KPIs such as turnaround time, fill rate, and error rate, surface key insights, and drive data-informed decisions.
* Act as a key liaison with pharmacy partners and vendors, ensuring issues are addressed quickly, feedback is gathered, and service levels are met.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Pharmacy, Clinical, Care, Product, and Data teams to develop strategies that improve the patient medication experience.
* Support innovation in pharmacy operations by researching best practices and industry trends to help shape Mochi's fulfillment roadmap.
* Manage and update operational content, including partner communication, training resources, SOPs, and workflows.
* Foster a team-first mindset: humility, collaboration, and partnership are key.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0 to 2 years of experience.
* Bachelor's Degree in STEM or a related field.
* Comfortable working full-time, in-office in our downtown San Francisco office.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You know how, when, and what to communicate with confidence and clarity.
* Experience working across teams and building relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Analytical and detail-oriented, with a proactive approach to solving problems.
* A strong communicator who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Interest in pharmacy, healthcare operations, or supply chain is a plus.

The base salary for this full-time position ranges from **$100,000 to $130,000 including benefits and stock options**. The salary range listed in each job posting represents the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all locations. Actual compensation within this range is determined by various factors, such as job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, and location.

**Life at Mochi**
-----------------

At Mochi, we believe your best work happens when you feel your best—so we've designed an environment that fuels your creativity, supports your growth, and makes every day exciting.

**✨ Comprehensive Health Coverage** –Robust medical, dental, and vision insurance to support your health—so you can feel your best, in and out of work.

**Financial Security** –Plan for your future with a 401(k) plus company matching and fully covered life insurance—because peace of mind matters.

**Time to Recharge** –Enjoy unlimited PTO, generous company holidays, and true flexibility. We trust you to take the time you need to rest, reset, and thrive.

**Wellness First** –From weekly mindfulness sessions to group workouts and fitness perks, your physical and mental health are top priority.

**Daily Fuel** –Our office is stocked with an *unlimited espresso and matcha bar*, plus delicious lunch served **five days a week**. No sad desk lunches here.

**Connection & Community** –We value real relationships. From team lunches and office hangs to offsite retreats, we create space to connect and collaborate.

**High-Impact Work** –Be part of shaping the future of digital healthcare during an exciting period of growth and innovation.

**Competitive Compensation** –We offer a top-of-market salary and a generous equity package—because you deserve to share in the upside you help create.

**‍ World-Class Team** –Join a team of thoughtful, driven professionals across engineering, product, clinical, operations, and beyond—each bringing excellence and empathy to the table.

**Profitable & Explosive Growth** – Our growth is like trying to drink from a firehose while riding a rocket, as we commit to decisions that ensure long-term success, stability, and the well-being of our team and customers—all without the constraints of VC funding.

**Prime Location** –Our vibrant downtown San Francisco HQ is just steps from public transit, great coffee shops, and everything the city has to offer.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The Program Manager of the Centralized Job Center (CJC) is responsible for running Goodwill’s Centralized Job Center in San Francisco, which is an America’s Job Center of California (AJCC). This position will be overseeing a team providing intensive career coaching support, assessments, and job placement services to dislocated workers, people seeking retraining, and others starting work for the first time. jobs.title: Dental Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Overall Summary:**

BACH Dental Program Managers are responsible for the successful management and operation of the site(s), and to assure the smooth operation of clinic based services and achievement of team-based productivity benchmarks. The Dental Program Manager monitors on-site dental clinic operations and is responsible for addressing and resolving day-to-day issues effecting clinic inefficiencies in patient flow by addressing system problems in a resourceful and effective manner. The Dental Program Manager makes scheduling adjustments necessary to improve or achieve optimal patient flow and monitors staff for safety and compliance related issues. This position must provide leadership in establishing and maintaining a professional and respectful environment that supports teamwork while promoting the dignity, privacy and confidentiality of patients, their families, co-workers and volunteers. The Dental Program Manager works closely with operations staff to support and achieve BACH’s goals and objectives including organizational quality and patient-centered care. This position has the ultimate authority to make changes in site operations, staff scheduling and discipline for all non-provider staff at that site, and works closely with Senior Clinical Leadership in resolving issues with site providers.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

Under the general direction of Director of Clinical Operations, the Dental Clinic Manager performs a variety of complex, professional, analytical, and confidential dental services. Duties include:

**Personnel Management, Training & Coordination:**

* Serve as liaison between Dental Director(s), Dental Supervisors, other clinical support staff, front desk, and administrative staff.
* Interview, hire, train, supervise, and evaluate clinic personnel.
* Working under the direction of the Director of Clinical Operations, responsible for all activities at the particular site, including monitoring and addressing clinic flow issues to maintain smooth operations and allow staff to provide high quality and timely care and services to patients.
* Work with the scheduling team to manage the Provider schedules and make adjustments due to last minute time off requests to meet the number of patient visits needed to support goals and objectives for patient volume
* Make site staffing allocation decisions and adjustments when necessary, such as determining if too many staff are on hand or not enough staff is present
* Monitors staff and arranges for training and/or counseling when needed to meet customer service expectations
* Coordinate audit preparation at the site and serve as site point person during the audit
* Plan, evaluate, recommend and implement new initiatives when appropriate
* Select and hire employees according to established guidelines. Monitor, coach, develop and evaluate performance of staff on an ongoing basis in accordance with applicable performance standards.
* Oversee licensed clinical staff in adherence to programs, protocols, quality assurance guidelines and ensure licenses are in good standing.
* Coordinate dental providers and clinic personnel schedules.
* Coordinate and document staff trainings, continuing education and staff meetings.
* Review staff time for payroll.
* Maintain current personnel information, certifications, licensures, and staff health exams etc.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Patient account manager
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova is building a fast-growing clinical network for its personalised cancer vaccine programme. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. We run the whole process for patients and their oncologists, from initial review through treatment and follow-up.

**The role**

We're looking for a Patient Account Manager to own each patient's experience from sign-up through to administration and follow-up. You'll be the main point of contact for the patient, their family, their physician and, where separate, the treatment sponsor-investigator. You'll answer their questions and keep every step on track.

Success looks like an excellent experience for every patient in our care, and a patient journey that runs smoothly and on time.

**What you'll do**

* Guide new patients and families through sign-up, consent paperwork, records requests and what to expect at each stage
* Coordinate sample collection and shipping with the patient's physician, pathology labs and sequencing partners, and track each sample through to results and analysis
* Keep patients, families and physicians regularly updated on sequencing, manufacturing and administration dates
* Answer non-clinical questions yourself, and quickly pass clinical or medical questions to our nursing, medical or scientific team
* Keep accurate, confidential records of each patient's status, communications and outstanding actions
* Arrange practical support such as travel, scheduling and help with financial-access questions

**Your first few months**

* Get to know Serova's personalised cancer vaccine programme end to end, from both our side and the patient's
* Take over communication and day-to-day management of patients already on the programme
* Set up patient trackers and make sure every outstanding action and question is dealt with

**What we're looking for**

* Experience in a patient-facing coordination role, such as patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support, ideally in oncology. If you've done similar work outside a clinical setting and have the right mindset, we'd still like to hear from you.
* A track record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across several external parties, such as clinics, labs and couriers
* Clear, compassionate communication with patients and families during a difficult time, and confidence working with physicians and their teams
* Careful handling of confidential health information, with working knowledge of HIPAA
* Good judgement about which questions to answer yourself and which to escalate to clinical colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience with personalised or autologous therapy programmes
* Specimen chain of custody
* Expanded-access or clinical-trial enrolment
* Patient CRM or case-management systems
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, California
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Salary:** $100,000 to $130,000

Questions? Email clinical@serova.bio

**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** P140091-2660347

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Case Managers are licensed nursing professionals responsible for coordinating continuum of care and discharge planning activities for a caseload of assigned patients. Major responsibilities include coordinating all facets of a patient's admission/discharge; performing utilization review activities, including review of patient charts for timeliness of services as well as appropriate utilization of services; and ensuring optimum use of resources, service delivery, and compliance with external review agencies' requirements. Case Managers act as consultants to the clinical team, service lines, and other departments regarding patient assessment and patient care and participate in program development and quality improvement initiatives. In their role, Case Managers, by applying guidelines and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, influence and direct the delivery and quality of patient care. A hospital-based case management system has as its primary goal to ensure the most appropriate use of services by patients and, toward that end, to avoid duplication and misuse of medical services, control costs by reducing inefficient services, and improve the effectiveness of care delivery. Objectives are to facilitate timely discharge; prompt, efficient use of resources; achievement of expected outcomes; collaborative practice; coordination of care across the continuum; and performance/quality improvement activities that lead to optimal patient outcomes. A Case Manager differs from other roles in professional nursing/health care practice in that it is not intended to provide direct patient care; rather, a Case Manager will be assigned to specific patients to ensure that the medical services and treatments required are accomplished in the most financially and clinically efficient manner.

LEAD WORK

* May lead the work of administrative/clinical support staff responsible for assisting with case management for an assigned patient caseload.

OTHER

jobs.description:
E-Commerce Customer Service & Order Operations Specialist  
TikTok Live-Commerce Jewelry Business  
On-Site | San Francisco, California  
$25–$32 per hour | Part-Time or Full-Time

About the Role

We are a fast-growing jewelry company selling through high-volume TikTok LIVE auctions. We are looking for a reliable, highly organized person to take ownership of daily customer-service and post-sale operations.

This person will help ensure that customer questions are answered promptly, returns and refunds are handled properly, orders are processed accurately, and packaging or fulfillment problems are identified before they affect customers.

The position requires someone who is comfortable switching between customer communication, computer-based administrative work, and hands-on order checking. As our business grows, this person will also help us improve and develop practical procedures for managing customer service, returns, order accuracy, and other after-sales issues.

Responsibilities

· Manage daily customer-service messages and resolve customer concerns promptly and professionally.

· Review and handle refund and return requests using good judgment and available order information.

· Inspect returned merchandise and help resolve discrepancies.

· Print and organize customer orders following livestreams.

· Monitor after-sales issues, including missing, damaged, delayed, or incorrect items.

· Help maintain packaging and order accuracy.

· Perform spot checks of completed orders and product trays to identify possible mistakes before shipment.

· Use order records, livestream information, and video receipts when researching discrepancies.

· Monitor negative reviews and assist with appropriate responses and resolutions.

· Keep clear and organized records of customer issues, returns, refunds, and unresolved cases.

· Communicate problems and recurring patterns to management.

· Coordinate with livestream, packaging, shipping, and warehouse employees.

· Help develop more effective procedures as order volume increases.

· Take on other related e-commerce and operational responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

· Experience in customer service, e-commerce, order processing, returns, fulfillment, quality control, or a similar role is preferred.

· Excellent attention to detail and the ability to notice small discrepancies.

· Strong organizational and time-management skills.

· Good judgment when evaluating customer complaints, refunds, and returns.

· Strong written communication skills and a professional manner with customers.

· Comfortable working with computers, spreadsheets, order systems, and online selling platforms.

· Able to investigate a problem, identify the likely cause, and follow it through to resolution.

· Able to work efficiently in a high-volume and fast-changing environment.

· Comfortable performing both administrative work and hands-on order checking.

· Dependable, responsible, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

· Willing to take initiative and help improve systems that are still being developed.

· Experience with TikTok Shop, livestream selling, jewelry, online marketplaces, or high-volume consumer orders is helpful but not required.

· No specific college degree is required.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is careful, practical, and accountable. You do not assume that an order or customer issue has been handled correctly—you verify it. You can recognize when something looks wrong, investigate the situation, and communicate clearly with the appropriate people.

You should also be comfortable joining a growing company where not every procedure has already been established. We want someone who can learn our business, handle current responsibilities reliably, and help us create better processes over time.

Schedule

This position may be part-time or full-time, depending on the candidate’s experience and availability. Some schedule flexibility may be needed to support our livestream and order-processing schedule, including occasional evenings or weekends.

This is an on-site position in San Francisco.

Compensation

$25–$32 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and briefly answer the following questions:

1. What relevant experience do you have with customer service, e-commerce, refunds, returns, order processing, or quality control?

2. Describe a situation in which you identified and resolved an order, inventory, or customer-service problem.

3. How do you stay accurate when working quickly or handling repetitive, high-volume tasks?

4. Are you looking for part-time or full-time work?

5. Are you available to work on-site in San Francisco?

Pay: $25.00 - $32.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
The Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and continuously improving learning programs that support associate growth, organizational effectiveness, and business objectives. This role owns the company's onboarding experience, collaborates with stakeholders to identify learning needs, develops engaging learning solutions, and manages programs from conception through evaluation.

The Learning & Development Specialist combines expertise in instructional design, program management, organizational development, and learning administration with a passion for creating impactful associate development experiences.

**Onboarding Program Management**

* Own and continuously enhance the end-to-end associate onboarding experience for new hires.
* Partner with HR, business leaders, and subject matter experts to ensure onboarding content remains current and aligned with business priorities.
* Manage onboarding schedules, communications, learning assignments, and program logistics.
* Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through feedback, participation metrics, and business outcomes, implementing improvements as needed.

**Learning Program Design & Development**

* Design, create, update, and maintain high-quality presentations, guides, videos, e-learning modules, facilitator materials, participant resources, job aids, and quick-reference tools.
* Translate complex information into practical, accessible, learner-centered content aligned with adult-learning principles, organizational standards, and Fremont Bank branding.
* Organize and maintain learning resources within the Learning Management System and approved shared-learning platforms.
* Support virtual, hybrid, and in-person learning delivery and troubleshoot routine learning-technology issues.
* Use approved AI-assisted content tools responsibly, validating accuracy, protecting confidential information, complying with licensing requirements, and applying appropriate human review.

**Organizational Development Support**

* Support organizational development initiatives that strengthen associate engagement, leadership capability, career development, talent readiness, and organizational effectiveness.
* Assist in the implementation of talent development programs and change management efforts.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to support a culture of continuous learning and growth.

**Program Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Manage multiple learning and development programs simultaneously, ensuring successful planning, execution, and delivery.
* Develop project plans, timelines, communication strategies, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate resources, stakeholders, facilitators, and vendors to ensure program success.
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate program effectiveness and impact.
* Recommend and implement enhancements based on data, stakeholder input, and best practices.

**Learning Administration**

* Maintain learning records, program documentation, and learning management system (LMS) data.
* Manage course enrollment, program communications, training calendars, and reporting.
* Ensure training materials and learning resources remain accurate and accessible.
* Support compliance and audit-related training requirements as needed.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with external training providers, consultants, and learning partners.
* Assist with vendor selection, scheduling, contracting, invoicing, and program delivery.
* Evaluate vendor performance and learning outcomes to ensure quality and alignment with organizational needs.

**Learning & Development Support**

* Serve as a trusted partner to associates, managers, and HR colleagues regarding learning and development resources.
* Stay informed on emerging L&D trends, technologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of the organization's learning strategy and associate development initiatives.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business, Psychology, or related field.
* 3 plus years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related function.
* Experience managing onboarding programs and employee development initiatives.
* Experience designing and delivering training content using instructional design methodologies.
* Experience managing projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of adult learning theory and instructional design models (ADDIE, SAM, or similar).
* Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and virtual learning platforms.
* Familiarity with organizational development and talent management practices.
* Training, facilitation, or coaching certification preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods (e.g., sitting or standing).
* Frequent use of a computer and other office equipment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and customers.
* Occasionally move or lift items up to 10 pounds.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Manager, Product Operations & UX
jobs.description:
Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
  
  
Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product.

What you’ll own

* **Operating model and cadence.** Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams.
* **Program management.** Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership.
* **Tooling and data.** Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing.
* AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization.
* **Design and research (UX).** Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch.

What you’ll do

* Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works.
* Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work.
* Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible.
* Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes.
* Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk.
* Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth.
* Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products.
* Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early.
* Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design.

What you bring

* 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models.
* Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization.
* Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track.
* Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system.
* Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth.
* People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives.

Nice to have

* Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain.
* Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment.
* Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development.

**Compensation**

The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position. The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

By combining technology-enabled MSK providers with proactive care coordination and decision support services, Icon Health delivers multidisciplinary, evidence-based care.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT WIPA**

The Wedding Industry Professionals Association (WIPA) is a national nonprofit association for wedding and event professionals, with chapters across the United States. Our members are business owners and practitioners who join for education, connection and credibility in their industry. Our chapters are run by volunteer boards who give their time on top of running their own businesses.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

This is one of the first three staff positions in WIPA's history.

WIPA is bringing its management in-house, moving onto a new association management platform, and building its operations from the ground up. The Operations Manager is the person who makes all of that hold together — and who gets to design it rather than maintain someone else's version of it.

This is the seat that keeps the record straight. Board minutes and packets. The data behind every number the association reports. Event registration and logistics. The document libraries, workflows and automation that mean WIPA's institutional knowledge lives in a system rather than in one person's head.

It is also the seat where good systems thinking shows up fastest. You will be asked what should be automated, and then given room to build it.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Keep the numbers true.** Maintain the accuracy of association data and produce monthly reporting on membership, retention, renewals and activity, reconciled to written definitions. Discrepancies should be found here first.
* **Support member retention from the back office.** Produce a weekly list of members expiring in the next 30, 60 and 90 days for the Senior Relationship Manager, and report each month which scheduled reminders and automations actually went out. The shared standard across both roles: no expiring member goes uncontacted.
* **Build the automation layer.** Design and maintain the connections between the association's database, workspace, accounting and communications tools. Keep a register of what runs, who owns it, when it runs and when it was last verified. Bring opportunities forward with the cost, security and data-privacy considerations attached. Document each workflow so it survives staff changes.
* **Support the National Board.** Scheduling, meeting materials, minutes, and tracking follow-up items through to closure.
* **Administer the systems.** The association's database, document storage and online resource libraries, with technical support coordinated through outside vendors.
* **Build the operating standard.** Develop and maintain the workflows, templates and standard operating procedures used across the association, so every chapter works from a common national standard. Coordinate national projects against timelines, responsibilities and deliverables. Build and maintain the training library.
* **Run event operations.** Set up and administer event registration, including reviewing chapter event registrations before they open. Manage logistics for national events — speaker coordination, materials, shipments, storage, on-site registration — and prepare and report on national event budgets.
* **Get communications out the door.** Build, schedule and distribute newsletters, campaigns and event communications against the approved calendar.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Administrative and coordination experience supporting an executive, a board or a small team
* Strong skills with spreadsheets, databases and reporting; experience administering a membership or customer database preferred
* Demonstrated experience designing or implementing automations, AI tools or workflow systems
* High attention to detail and accuracy in record keeping
* Event operations experience, including registration and on-site support
* A service mindset toward volunteers and colleagues, and the ability to explain technical topics in plain language
* Willingness to travel for national events and the national conference

If you are the person who has quietly automated half of your current job, we would like to hear from you.

Past or current WIPA membership is a plus, but it is not required and does not by itself qualify a candidate. These roles are open to applicants inside and outside the WIPA community, and will be filled on merit.

**COMPENSATION AND EMPLOYMENT TERMS**

**Salary: $85,000 – $100,000 annually**, depending on experience. Final terms are set with WIPA's Treasurer, Finance Committee and legal counsel.

This is a W-2 employee position, exempt. WIPA covers employer payroll taxes and workers' compensation coverage.

**Benefits: WIPA does not offer health, dental, vision or retirement benefits at this time.** We would rather tell you that now than in a third interview. WIPA is standing up its employment structure for the first time, and benefits are a decision in front of the Board rather than something we can promise today.

**Location:** remote, from anywhere in the United States. WIPA will complete employer registration in the successful candidate's state.

**One thing to know going in:** this role carries the heaviest load during WIPA's platform migration. For roughly the first year you will be running the current system and the new one side by side and verifying that what moved across is correct. It is real work, and it is the reason the rest of the job becomes possible.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email a résumé and a short note about why this role interests you to mallory@wipa.org.

Applications are reviewed as they arrive. Target start date is November 16, 2026.

Manage DSPM activities across AWS, Microsoft 365, file shares, databases, and unstructured data repositories using Securiti.AI and related tools.

Lead data discovery, classification, entitlement analysis, least-privilege remediation, tagging, cataloguing, and tokenization activities.

Excellent stakeholder management, analytical, reporting, presentation, and executive communication skills.

Entouch is a leader in smart building and energy management technology, helping multi-site businesses reduce energy usage, optimize operations, and improve building performance. We combine a cloud-based platform with exceptional service to help customers operate smarter, more efficient facilities.

Headquartered in Richardson, TX, Entouch welcomes remote and hybrid candidates for this position. Learn more at www.entouchcontrols.com.

We are seeking a Deployment Project Manager to lead the installation, commissioning, and successful delivery of Entouch energy management systems across commercial facilities nationwide. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between customers, subcontractors, field teams, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to Entouch quality standards.

* Lead end-to-end deployment activities for assigned installation projects

**Scope & Financial Management**

* Identify, document, and manage change orders and out-of-scope work
* Support contract adjustments and customer negotiations as needed
* Monitor project financial performance and support cost forecasting activities

**Continuous Improvement & Safety**

* Provide field feedback to Engineering and Product teams to improve product quality and deployment processes
* Support training initiatives for internal teams and subcontractors
* Promote and uphold all company and site safety standards

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Education**

* 3–5 years of project management experience in HVAC controls, building automation systems (BAS), mechanical systems, or related commercial construction environments
* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, HVAC, or a related technical discipline preferred

**Technical Knowledge**

* Understanding of commercial HVAC systems, controls, and installation practices
* Familiarity with BAS/DDC controls and low-voltage electrical systems
* Ability to read construction drawings, wiring diagrams, and project specifications

* Strong communication and customer relationship management skills
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills
* Comfortable working independently in fast-paced field environments
* Willingness to travel approximately 10–20% domestically

**Work Environment**

This role includes occasional travel to commercial job sites across the United States, typically averaging 10–20% travel. Work may be performed in indoor and outdoor environments with occasional exposure to construction-related conditions including noise, dust, temperature fluctuations, and active mechanical or electrical systems. Flexibility for occasional after-hours support, commissioning activities, and limited travel is required.

**Why Entouch**

* Competitive compensation package

jobs.title: Remote Patient Enrollment Specialist – Medical Sales
jobs.description:
Overview  
Turn Patient Interest Into Meaningful Next Steps

Our growing functional medicine and naturopathic clinic is seeking an experienced phone sales professional to help prospective patients understand our services and take the next step toward care.

As a **Remote Patient Enrollment Specialist**, you will speak with inbound leads who have already expressed interest in our clinic. You’ll build rapport, understand their goals, explain services and pricing, address concerns, and guide qualified patients through enrollment.

This position combines consultative sales, patient education, and consistent follow-up. Success requires confidence discussing costs, asking for commitment, and working toward measurable sales goals.

What We Offer

* **Inbound leads:** Connect with people who have already expressed interest—no cold calling.
* **Guaranteed base pay:** $17/hour plus uncapped commission.
* **Performance-based earning potential:** Fully trained advisors typically earn $21–$30/hour in combined base pay and commission. Actual earnings vary by performance.
* **Remote work:** Work from a quiet, professional home office.
* **Paid time off and flexible scheduling.**
* **Meaningful conversations:** Help prospective patients make informed decisions about pursuing care.

What You’ll Do

* Conduct structured phone consultations with prospective patients to understand their interests, concerns, and readiness to move forward.
* Explain clinic services, the care process, pricing, and enrollment steps using clear, approved information.
* Build trust through active listening, empathy, and confident communication.
* Address questions and objections related to cost, timing, and commitment.
* Ask for the sale and guide interested, qualified patients through the next steps.
* Follow up consistently with leads who need additional information or time to decide.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including contact activity, conversation notes, follow-up tasks, and enrollment status.
* Meet daily, weekly, and monthly goals for outreach activity, follow-up, conversion, and enrollment.
* Review performance metrics and apply feedback to improve results.
* Coordinate with the clinical team and direct questions about medical suitability, treatment recommendations, or expected outcomes to qualified providers.

What You Bring

**Required qualifications:**

* At least 1 year of phone sales, inside sales, medical sales, high-ticket sales, or similar consultative sales experience.
* A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas or conversion goals.
* Strong phone communication, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.
* Confidence discussing pricing and asking for financial commitment.
* Strong organization and consistent follow-through across multiple leads.
* Comfort working in a performance-focused environment with clear KPIs.
* A quiet, professional workspace and reliable internet connection.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, functional medicine, wellness, or patient enrollment.
* Experience selling services that require a consultative conversation.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and remote sales workflows.

**Location:** Fully Remote  
**Job Type:** Full-time; part-time considered for experienced candidates  
**Compensation:** $17/hour guaranteed base + uncapped commission  
**Typical total earnings:** $21–$30/hour for fully trained advisors, with higher earning potential based on performance

What Success Looks Like

You build trust quickly, explain information clearly, and help patients make informed decisions without pressure or promises of medical results. You take ownership of your follow-up, keep accurate records, and consistently work toward your enrollment and conversion goals.

Apply Today

If you have a proven phone sales background and enjoy combining empathy with results, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your resume and examples of your sales performance.

Pay: $17.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* How many years of phone sales, inside sales, medical sales, or patient enrollment experience do you have? Briefly describe the services or products you sold.
* What sales quotas or conversion goals were you responsible for in your most recent role, and what results did you achieve?
* Are you comfortable discussing pricing, handling objections, and asking prospective patients to commit financially over the phone?
* Are you comfortable with a compensation structure of $17/hour base pay plus performance-based commission?
* Do you have a quiet, professional workspace and reliable internet connection for a remote phone sales position?

Engagements are contracted per course, so you can take one course or several depending on your capacity. Most courses run eight to fourteen weeks of development.

This is a collaborative role. You will work directly with your SME on a regular cadence, and there are project and client calls from time to time. If you are looking for work that can be done entirely asynchronously with no contact with faculty or the client, this is not that role.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

**Design and development**

Partner with a faculty subject matter expert to develop the course plan: learning outcomes, assessment map, and the overall shape of the course.

Write the course guide or blueprint, the document that contains everything that will be built in the LMS. This includes instructional narrative, activity and assessment design, rubrics where used, and links to resources.

Review and write learning outcomes using Bloom's Taxonomy and related frameworks, making sure they are stated in performance terms, pitched to the audience, and sequenced to match the course design.

Design formative and summative assessments, knowledge checks and learning activities that actually measure the outcomes.

Draft a media plan with the SME, specifying what each asset is for, which outcome it addresses and roughly how long it should be, then work with media producers and interactive developers to get it made.

Work to the client's templates, style guide, terminology and design standards, which differ by client and which we will give you at kickoff.

Hold the standards: accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the client's style guide, and the design standards for the project. Remediating accessibility issues in your own deliverables is part of the work.

**Meetings and collaboration**

Hold regular working sessions with your subject matter expert through the design phase. Plan on a standing weekly meeting. The course gets designed in those conversations, and a designer who only emails the SME will not get what the course needs.

Attend additional project and client calls as necessary, or as your contract stipulates.

**Project administration**

Keep your own task status current in the client's project system (usually ClickUp). The project manager owns the schedule, but nobody can run a schedule off tasks that are not updated.

Run the review and approval process for your courses: submit on the dates in the plan, use the client's review request form, and route it to the named reviewers.

Review the built course in the LMS against your approved blueprint, log what needs fixing in one place, confirm the fixes landed, and sign off before it goes to the client.

Raise problems early. If a date is going to slip, an SME has gone quiet, or the scope has crept, say so while it can still be managed.

**HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS**
----------------------------

Contracted per course under a work for hire agreement. Deliverables are owned by the client.

Paid a fixed fee per course at defined milestones, on acceptance of each deliverable. This is not hourly work and there is no timesheet.

A defined number of review cycles is included in the fee. The cycle count, the turnaround time we expect from you, and the revision window are stated in your contract.

Revisions requested inside that window are included. Work beyond it, or a change to the course scope after sign off, is handled as a contract amendment before it is started, not after.

Course assignments can change. Courses get added, removed, delayed or reassigned by the client. When that happens we amend the contract rather than absorbing it quietly.

You will work in our systems and the client's: Google Workspace, Slack, the project system, and the client's LMS. Some clients provide guest access with rules attached, and we will tell you what those are.

We use AI tooling in our process, including our own platform. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to be comfortable working alongside it and following our rules about what client content can and cannot be put into external tools.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**
-----------------------

Experience designing courses in higher education, K-12 or workforce learning and development, with at least one full course taken from outline to delivery.

Fluency with learning management systems, Canvas and Brightspace in particular.

The ability to work with a faculty subject matter expert who is an expert in their field but not in course design, and to lead that relationship without taking it over.

Comfort in client-facing conversations, including ones where you have to say no or explain why something will not work.

Clear, structured writing and the discipline to follow a style guide and a template rather than your own preferred format.

The self-management to hit dates in a distributed team without being chased.

A degree in education, instructional design, instructional technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Candor about what you have not done. We would much rather know at the application stage that you have never built an interactive or never worked in Brightspace than find out when it blocks a deliverable.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

Experience with Articulate Storyline or Rise, H5P, or other interactive development tools.

Familiarity with Quality Matters or similar course design standards.

Experience picking up a partially built course from another designer and finishing it.

Experience using AI tools as part of a design workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not.

Experience in a specific discipline area: business, criminal justice, education, psychology, healt

* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

* Ability to lift 35 lbs

**Range:** $ 34 - 35.50/hourly

new_jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a full-time, highly motivated **Resident Services Coordinator & After-School Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Formal Job Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, Full-Time 34 hours per week (14 hours per week Director of Social Services/20 hours per week Program Coordinator)
* **Job location:** Oakland/Alameda, CA
* **Pay: $21.00 per hour (Program Coordinator), $28.35-$30.00 per hour (Director of Social Services)**

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

new_jobs.description:
At Episcopal Community Services (ECS), employees work with participants who may be experiencing homelessness, behavioral health conditions, substance use challenges, and other difficult life circumstances. While this work is meaningful and mission-driven, it can at times be stressful, demanding, or unpredictable. Employees are expected to exercise sound judgment, remain aware of their surroundings, follow established safety, communication, and de-escalation procedures, participate in all required trainings, and promptly report incidents, threats, injuries, or unsafe conditions, in accordance with ECS policies and procedures.

This position is a fully onsite, client-facing role that requires in-person interaction and direct service delivery to participants at ECS program locations. Due to the essential nature of the duties and the need for consistent in-person engagement with clients, remote work or work-from-home arrangements are not available for this position.

**SUMMARY OF DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Healthy Aging Program Coordinator will oversee the DAS-funded meal programs, currently serving over 6000 meals each month at three ECS sites; Canon Kip Senior Center, 1064/66 Mission, and The Granada Hotel.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Responsible for coordination of administrative and educational aspects of the DAS-funded meals program at three sites.
* Collect all daily meal recording data from all sites, assuring accurate and timely information.
* Provide accurate meal recording, assurance of proper lunch service protocols, and garner feedback from consumers.
* Facilitate the distribution and collection of the annual consumer survey at all sites.
* Work with Director of Healthy Aging and Director of CHEFs to identify and reduce areas of waste.
* Coordinate the collection of all monetary contributions at each site according to the program’s strict requirements.
* Support all sites with database entries of new intakes, annual assessment renewals, and quarterly recertifications.
* Assist third-party organizations to facilitate nutritional education sessions at three sites, selecting appropriate topics and collecting accurate attendance
* Act as a liaison between the ECS kitchen and individual site needs for optimal quality assurance.
* Ensure all required signage is posted at all sites.
* Attend staff and community meetings as needed.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* At least 1 year experience in program coordination, project management or a related field is required
* Some experience working with people experiencing homelessness is preferred
* Collaborative work style, demonstrating initiative and flexibility
* Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
* Computer and technology proficiency is required, with the ability to learn new applications quickly
* Commitment to ECS’s mission and to its organizational values
* Must be able to lift at least 10 pounds

**OTHER:**

Must secure annual TB test. Must be finger “imaged”. All offers are contingent on successful passing this background check. Will honor and abide by rules of confidentiality. Office space will be shared and will function as a group room when not in use as an office.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager to launch programs on time, surface the bottlenecks that put those launches at risk, and drive them to resolution. This role is ideal for a structured problem solver who can take ambiguous, cross-functional issues, turn them into clear workstreams, and hold action owners accountable until the work is closed.

The ideal candidate brings a consulting background — or equivalent experience solving diverse problems across many projects — with the executive communication skills to brief leadership and the working-level presence to operate across the organization. You will run a diverse set of initiatives in parallel, distill noise into the few issues that matter, and make sure business needs are met in a fast-moving supply chain environment.

 **What You'll Do**

* Program launch execution: Drive supply chain workstreams so programs launch on time. Identify critical-path bottlenecks across suppliers, internal teams, and sites, and stay on them until they are resolved
* Ambiguity to action: Take unstructured, cross-functional problems and distill them into scoped projects with owners, timelines, and success criteria. Follow up with action owners until issues are closed
* Executive communication: Own leadership communication on key issues, risks, and progress. Distill complex operational noise into clear, decision-ready updates for executives while remaining close to the working level
* Cross-functional problem solving: Partner with Procurement, Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and suppliers to diagnose root causes, align on trade-offs, and implement durable fixes
* Portfolio management: Run multiple initiatives in parallel without dropping business-critical work. Prioritize against launch dates, supply risk, and operational impact so business needs stay met
* Operating cadence: Stand up the forums, trackers, and escalation paths needed to keep launches and issue resolution moving. Surface trends early and drive continuous improvement
* Influence without authority: Build trust across functions and levels. Drive alignment and accountability in a matrixed environment where you may not own every resource

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in supply chain operations, program management, or a similarly structured, cross-functional problem-solving role
* Consulting background strongly preferred — experience solving diverse problems across multiple projects, with demonstrated executive communication
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous problems, structure them into functional workstreams, and drive action owners to resolution
* Track record of launching programs or delivering complex initiatives on time in a fast-paced operational environment
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including briefing executives and working effectively with all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage a diverse set of initiatives in parallel while keeping business needs, priorities, and stakeholders aligned
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills (issue trees, root cause analysis, 5-Why, data-driven recommendations)
* Comfort operating in a high-ambiguity, high-velocity manufacturing or supply chain environment
* Experience influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

$144,800 - $288,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
