Are you passionate about solving complex business problems, diving deep into data, driving process improvement, and leading change throughout an organization? Are you energized by putting emerging AI capabilities to work in how you operate every day? The AWS Strategic Accounts Business Operations team is seeking an experienced Sales Operations Lead to partner with our account management teams to define, land, and execute against our strategic priorities. You will partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to develop standard metrics that measure the productivity and success of programs, automate and optimize operational processes, and invent new ways of diving deep with data to uncover actionable insights. You will look around corners, measure the organization's performance, supply sales leadership with timely insights on the health of their business, and manage the operating cadence for the team.  
  
Strategic Accounts is one of AWS's most important and complex businesses — a portfolio of recognized industry leaders unlike any other segment. Working closely with senior sales leaders and executives, this role demands sharp judgment, precision, and executive-level communication: the ability to turn complexity into clear insight and to identify the true business signals that drive confident leadership decisions.  
  
The successful candidate has excellent business and sales acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, deep analytics experience, broad technical skills, and a demonstrated ability to both execute and influence. They are willing to roll up their sleeves, dive deep to learn, work comfortably within ambiguity, and have a passion for driving operational excellence.  
  
Above all, this role calls for someone who embodies Learn and Be Curious in the era of AI. Our business is evolving at the speed of AI, and so is how we work — we want a builder who is relentlessly curious about new AI capabilities (such as Amazon Quick), who invests the time to learn them deeply, and applies them to real problems to work faster and smarter. But curiosity goes beyond AI: it means getting to the bottom of complex business problems with many interdependencies, seeking the root cause rather than treating the symptom, and bringing a constant process-improvement mindset. The right person treats every new capability and hard problem as a chance to eliminate manual toil, surface insights earlier, and quantify the impact — in time saved or quality improved — while sharing what they learn and influencing others to adopt what works.  
  
In this role you will provide thought leadership for the organization. You will develop unique insights that drive dynamic decision making, set high standards, and use advanced technology to enable productivity. You will build strong relationships across the organization, tie insights to business strategy and results, and act as a proactive problem-solver who looks around corners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities for process or data improvement.  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and business where you'll have a high impact.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Sales Operations Lead, your role is critical and highly visible across the organization. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
  
Own revenue analysis and forecast accuracy for your accounts, surfacing the "why" behind weekly and monthly trends and variance drivers in partnership with Finance and ProServe.  
Drive measurable improvement in pipeline quality and hygiene, and use pipeline and revenue data to identify white space, resource optimization, and pipeline generation opportunities.  
Build and run the operating cadence for your account teams, including Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, elevating them toward forward-looking risks, opportunities, and leadership actions.  
Lead strategic and annual planning — territory planning, quota setting, goal setting, and account planning — and help teams turn plans into trackable, executable initiatives.  
Design and manage goals and metrics mechanisms that drive accountability, and curate qualitative customer insights into timely signals for leadership.  
Develop actionable, automated, self-service dashboards and reports.  
Drive process improvement and change management, leading and delivering training.  
Define tooling requirements and influence central teams' roadmaps to meet our high standards.  
Collaborate with other Operations leads to share and implement best practices.  
Lead adoption of AI tooling for operational use cases, quantifying the impact.  
Prepare ad hoc analysis and participate in projects as needed.  
  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing,

new_jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Strategic Accounts
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

A Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with AWS high-value strategic customer. Key aspects of the role include:  
  

* Relationship Management: Building deep, multi-threaded executive relationships, serving as the primary point of accountability for the overall account.

  

* Strategic Account Planning: creating and executing long-term account strategy that span quarters (not weeks), aligning cross-functional resources e.g. sales, customer success, product, and executive leadership.

  

* Revenue Expansion: owning revenue growth and identifying growth opportunities proactively, often before the customer realizes the need.

  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a strategic account and owning the overall account strategy, relationship health, and long-term growth trajectory  
  
Develop and execute multi-year strategic account plans that align AWS services and solutions with customer business objectives, driving adoption across compute, storage, database, analytics, AI/ML, and generative AI workloads  
  
Build and maintain deep, multi-threaded executive relationships across all levels of the customer organization  
  
Drive revenue growth by identifying expansion opportunities, accelerating new workload migrations, and positioning AWS as the preferred cloud platform across the customer's global operations  
  
Collaborate cross-functionally with AWS specialist teams, solutions architects, partner managers, professional services, and executive leadership to deliver tailored solutions that address complex customer needs  
  
Lead strategic negotiations for large-scale enterprise agreements, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and Marketplace procurement strategies  
  
Act as the customer's advocate within Amazon, influencing product roadmaps and service improvements by capturing and communicating customer feedback, feature requests, and competitive insights  
  
Monitor account health metrics, pipeline development, and revenue attainment against targets, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to retention and growth

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent
* 10+ years of sales or sales management in infrastructure or cloud technology experience
* Experience in managing global stakeholders
* Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams
* 5+ years of business development, or account management with a proven ability to deliver results experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with customers on substantial, strategic, and complex software or cloud services/infrastructure deals from opportunity through closure
* Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
* Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
* Experience in building and developing a high performance team

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  
USA, CA, Mountain View - 187,000.00 - 252,900.00 USD annually

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager - Eastbay
new_jobs.description:
**Area Operations Manager – East Bay**
======================================

BODYROK · Full-time · Salaried (exempt)

BODYROK offers high-intensity, low-impact workouts that will tone, refine, and sculpt your body & mind in just 45 minutes. Our instructors have earned the reputation for delivering some of the most challenging and comprehensive workouts in California. We combine our proprietary Hybrid Pilates method taught on custom-built reformers to deliver one of the most efficient full-body workouts there is. Our trainers are connected to a microphone instructing to heart-pumping music in high-energy studios. The BODYROK method is built to be high-intensity & low-impact leaving our clients energized and feeling great!

We are looking for enthusiastic, motivated, and hardworking individuals who are passionate about health, fitness, and the BODYROK brand.

**Studio locations:** Berkeley, Oakland, Rockridge, Alamo, Walnut Creek (6th studio coming soon)

**Reports to:** Operations Director

**Job Summary**

* The Area Operations Manager ensures that all operations functions within the studio provide the best member experience, and team member environment, and contribute to the studio's financial success.

  

* The Operations Manager recruits, interviews, trains, develops, and schedules a diverse team and provides leadership and direction to ensure the team achieves goals.

  

* This position is responsible for communicating and upholding company policies, and standards and delivering on our commitment to a clean, friendly, and well-maintained studio.

  

* Responsible for the successful attainment of studio targets (e.g. member service, cleanliness, revenue, and retention).

  

* Ensures that the facility is well equipped, and provides a clean and safe environment for both members and employees.

  

* The primary duty of this role is management. The majority of working time is spent managing studio operations and directing, scheduling, training and evaluating the studio team.

  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage studio operations/studio walkthroughs

  

* Manage Studio Advisor scheduling

  

* Manage Studio Advisor time & attendance

  

* Create and implement retail & water inventory/sales reporting

  

* Studio Advisor hiring i.e. phone interviews & assist with in-person interviews

  

* Manage Studio Advisor onboarding

  

* Manage studio binders

  

* Manage Studio Advisor written warnings and disciplinary documentation

  

* Manage time and attendance and payroll submission for Studio Advisors

  

* Manage supply logs - per studio

  

* Supply distribution as needed

  

* Oversee cleanliness of studios

  

* Manage studio audits

  

* Manage and conduct Studio Advisor performance reviews

  

* Manage community events for the East Bay. Must have a strong passion for building community in and outside of the studio and have a passion to build community in the two new markets we are going into this year.

  

* Coordinate studio repairs and maintenance through approved vendors. This role is not required to perform repair, maintenance or construction work.

  

* Available for occasional weekend coverage, in studio or at a community event, on a rotating schedule

  

* Must be available three times a week for team conference calls

  

* Must be in studio a minimum of five days a week

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in the studio; move about studio floors and rooms; review, revise, and create studio paperwork; communicate with employees, members, and the public

  

* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.

  

* The employee occasionally sits, walks, kneels, and reaches with hands and arms

  

* These requirements may be met with or without reasonable accommodation.

  

**Work Environment**

* While performing the duties of this job, regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts

  

* The noise level in the environment is loud

  

* Ability to work a varied schedule to support the needs of the business, including frequent extended workdays, weekends and holidays may be required

  

**Travel**

* Must have a personal vehicle to travel between studios.

  

**Time Off**

* Employees on PTO, sick leave or scheduled days off are not expected to work or respond to work matters. Coverage will be arranged in advance.

  

Position

* Full-time, Salary

  

*BODYROK is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Employment with BODYROK is at-will.*

*This position description intends to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. It is not intended to include all duties and responsibilities. The order in which duties and responsibilities are listed is not significant.*

new_jobs.title: CCAC Regional Supervisor - Operations & Onboarding Support
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Location: Remote (California-based required). Preference for Sacramento, Fresno, and Stockton areas  
Reports to: Program Manager, California Climate Action Corps  
Status: Full-Time, Exempt  
Salary: $83,300–$89,100 annually (DOE)  
Start Date: Open until filled

Benefits:

* 3+ weeks vacation
* 14 paid holidays + additional sick leave
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and mental health coverage
* 403(b) retirement plan
* Annual career development funds
* Remote position, but occasional travel throughout California expected

**About California Climate Action Corps (CCAC)**
------------------------------------------------

California Climate Action Corps (CCAC), a state service program led by California Volunteers, Office of the Governor, and implemented by Bay Area Community Resources (BACR), mobilizes emerging leaders to take direct climate action in communities across California. With over 400 fellows and 100+ host partners, CCAC supports impactful service projects focused on urban greening, organic waste and edible food recovery, wildfire resiliency, and climate education and volunteer engagement. The program is rooted in service, equity, and sustainability.

### **Position Summary**

The Regional Supervisor – Operations & Onboarding is a dynamic, multifaceted role responsible for both regional fellowship support and critical program operations for the California Climate Action Corps (CCAC). Approximately half of the role focuses on serving as a Regional Supervisor for a cohort of Fellows and Host Partners, while the other half focuses on owning key administrative, financial, compliance, and operational processes that support a 400+ Fellow, 100+ Host Partner Fellowship.

As a Regional Supervisor, this position serves as a primary program liaison across multiple Host Partner sites, providing ongoing support to Fellows and their Site Supervisors, conducting monthly virtual check-ins and bi-annual in-person visits, supporting professional development, and helping ensure a successful Fellowship experience. On the operations side, this position will own high-volume, detail-oriented processes including timecard administration, reimbursements, financial reporting, and offer support for onboarding and offboarding, compliance tracking, and audits.

This role requires someone who can zoom in on the details while keeping the big picture in view. The ideal candidate is a proactive and organized self-starter who takes ownership of complex processes, effectively manages competing priorities, and thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operations & Finance**

* Own and manage the fellowship timecard approval process and reporting for 400+ fellows, including reviewing, tracking, and resolving timecard issues
* Manage fellowship reimbursements, review documentation for accuracy and compliance, and coordinate timely processing
* Organize, prepare, and submit financial reports, ensuring information is accurate, complete, and submitted by required deadlines
* Coordinate key onboarding and offboarding processes for 400+ fellows annually
* Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems and processes, taking initiative to create greater consistency, efficiency, and accountability
* Support program audits by maintaining organized records, gathering documentation, and responding to requests

### **Fellow Regional Supervision**

* Support the professional development of each AmeriCorps Fellow
* Help facilitate and plan member development training days, community building, and celebrations
* Act as Regional Supervisor for fellows and host partners, meeting virtually on a monthly basis and occasionally conducting in-person site visits
* Collect all member evaluation and metrics reporting documentation
* Oversee and approve AmeriCorps timesheets, track AmeriCorps hours, and support fellow professional development and post-fellowship transition

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
  + Program or operations administration
  + Finance, financial administration, or grant administration
  + Compliance, reporting, or audit support
  + Onboarding or human resources support
  + Stakeholder or partnership coordination
  + Nonprofit, AmeriCorps, or other service-oriented programs
* A highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter who can take ownership of complex processes from start to finish, manage high-volume work and competing priorities, and maintain accuracy across multiple systems
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate challenging conversations, balance competing needs, and follow through
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to provide guidance and support to Fellows, Host Partners, and internal team members
* Adaptability and resilience in a fast-moving environment, with the ability to adjust to changing program needs and priorities
* Strong remote-work skills, including proactive communication, accountability, and responsiveness
* Experience with project management, reporting, Salesforce, Slack, Google Suite, or the ability to learn new systems quickly
* Experience with sustainability, environmental, or AmeriCorps programs, and familiarity with California environmental policy is a plus

**About Bay Area Community Resources**
--------------------------------------

Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) promotes the healthy development of individuals, families, and communities through direct services, volunteerism, and partnerships in California. Bay Area Community Resources is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Visit our website at www.bacr.org.

**About Us:**

Bay Area Community Resources (BACR) promotes the healthy development of individuals

new_jobs.title: Manager, People Operations
new_jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

Muon is built on a vision of a world that sees itself clearly—where real-time planetary insight drives action to protect lives, build resilience, and compound into shared prosperity. To support this mission, Muon seeks a People Operations Manager to join our rapidly growing People Operations team. The ideal candidate is a highly empathetic, high-integrity leader who will serve as the operational bedrock of our employee experience. Reporting to the VP of People Operations, you will lead a dedicated team delivering operational excellence across the employee experience balancing strategic scaling and compliance with a deeply human-centric approach.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week. Could flex to accommodate remote for exceptional candidates who are located in the West Coast timezone and could travel to the Bay Area at least once a quarter.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Directly partnering with the VP of People Operations to design and execute scalable HR strategies, programs, and infrastructure built for rapid headcount growth to support the company.
* Ensure seamless execution across the employee lifecycle from onboarding, benefits administration, payroll processing, internal employee support and offboarding.
* Foster an inclusive, supportive, and kind workplace culture grounded in integrity, psychological safety, and clear communication.
* Design, launch, and analyze regular pulse surveys to measure employee engagement, gather actionable feedback, and drive continuous improvement in workplace culture.
* Maintain full compliance with federal, state, and local labor laws (including FLSA, FMLA, ADA, and aerospace-specific regulations like ITAR/EAR), and continuously update company policies as needed.
* Lead annual Open Enrollment, vendor management, and benefits strategy to ensure competitive and compassionate total rewards packages.
* Oversee accuracy and compliance in payroll workflows, HRIS management, and time-tracking systems.
* Lead and empower your team and be a role model for the company of management capability.
* Serve as a trusted, approachable point of contact for employees, handling complex personal or professional inquiries with total confidentiality.
* Manage sensitive employee relations and conflict resolution with fairness, discretion, and deep emotional intelligence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience**: 8–12+ years of progressive experience in People Operations or Human Resources, with at least 4+ years of direct people management experience.
* **Scaling & Growth**: Proven track record of building, scaling, and managing People Operations functions through rapid hyper-growth phases.
* **Autonomy & Drive**: Proven ability to translate broad business goals into actionable project roadmaps and execute independently with minimal direction.
* **Total Rewards Strategy**: Strategic expertise in Total Rewards and benefits design, vendor negotiations, and overseeing end-to-end Open Enrollment strategy.
* **Problem Solving & Discretion**: Demonstrated mastery in handling complex employee relations, internal investigations, and sensitive organizational challenges with exceptional emotional intelligence, discretion, and high integrity.
* **Executive Partnership**: Strong executive presence with proven success advising and partnering with stakeholders across our growing organization on people strategies.
* **Communication Skills**: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with a natural approachability and warmth.
* **Adaptability**: Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with new challenges each week.
* **Systems and Documentation**: Hands-on experience architecting and managing modern HR systems (Rippling, Lattice) and building out accessible and clear documentation (Google Workspace, Confluence).

**Nice-to-have Skills**
-----------------------

* **Legal Compliance**: Deep knowledge of multi-state federal, state, and local employment laws, compliance frameworks, and complex HR governance.
* **Aerospace Regulations**: Familiarity with ITAR/EAR regulatory compliance and security clearances and its implications on talent acquisition, onboarding, and export control workflows.

**Salary**
----------

The salary range for this role is $193,000 - $214,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

**About Muon Space**
--------------------

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

**Taking Care of Our Team**
---------------------------

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry

new_jobs.title: Office Manager & People Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
To see the original job post please visit our website: https://versavascular.com/job/office-manager-people-operations-coordinator/

**Description**

Versa Vascular is an innovative medical device startup developing next-generation implantable solutions for the treatment of tricuspid heart valve disease. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes through precision engineering, rigorous quality standards, and collaborative innovation.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and people-oriented **Office Manager & People Operations Coordinato**r to support the day-to-day operations for Versa Vascular. This role serves as the hub of office operations, employee engagement, and HR coordination, helping to create an efficient, welcoming, and compliant workplace environment.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing multiple hats, thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, and enjoys supporting both operational and employee-focused initiatives. This position will also provide limited executive support to the CEO.

This role will **start in Santa Cruz and move to Los Gatos early 2027.** The work duties will temporarily include coordinating and preparing various aspects of the company move.

**Office Management**

* Manage daily office operations to ensure a productive and professional work environment.
* Maintain inventory and ordering of office, kitchen, and breakroom supplies.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for office-related vendors and service providers.
* Support workplace organization, safety, and general office functionality.

**Human Resources Coordination**

* Serve as the primary internal liaison with the company’s outsourced HR consulting team.
* Assist employees with benefits enrollment and benefits-related communications.
* Coordinate performance review cycles and employee communications.
* Help communicate company policies, procedures, and HR initiatives.
* Support onboarding activities for new hires and coordinate required documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling employee and company information.

**Recruiting & Interview Coordination**

* Schedule and coordinate in-person candidate interviews.
* Manage interview logistics, including room scheduling and candidate communications.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the interview process.
* Coordinate interview schedules among hiring managers and candidates.

**Employee Engagement & Event Planning**

* Help foster a positive and engaging workplace culture!
* Plan and coordinate company lunches, team celebrations, happy hours, and BBQs.
* Organize annual company events, employee recognition activities, and other culture-building initiatives.
* Manage event logistics, vendors, catering, budgets, and communications.

**Executive Support**

* Provide limited executive assistance to the CEO.
* Coordinate business travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries.
* Assist with occasional scheduling and administrative support as needed.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3+ years of experience in office management, human resources coordination, executive support, or a related administrative role.
* Comfortable adapting to changing priorities in a growing startup environment.
* Collaborative team player who enjoys supporting employees and leadership.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and common business software platforms.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.
* Highly trustworthy and capable of handling confidential information.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a startup, medical device, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industry environment.
* Experience supporting HR functions or working with outsourced HR providers.
* Familiarity with benefits administration and employee lifecycle processes.
* Event planning and vendor management experience.

**Why Join Versa Vascular**

* Help bring innovative structural heart therapies to patients with significant unmet clinical needs.
* Work alongside a highly experienced team of clinical, engineering, and cardiovascular experts.
* Influence clinical strategy and execution at a critical stage of company growth.
* Competitive compensation, equity participation, and comprehensive benefits.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Assistant Construction Project Manager is a junior, field-based role that supports a Construction Project Manager across their portfolio of active ADU and residential builds. This person is the PM’s eyes and ears in the field - visiting job sites, documenting progress, and handling the coordination and follow-up that keeps projects moving. It is a developmental position built for someone young, ambitious, and technically curious who wants to learn the PM role from the ground up and grow into managing their own portfolio within roughly 12–18 months.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* **Serve as the PM’s eyes and ears in the field** — conduct site visits across the PM’s active projects to observe progress, quality, and site conditions, and report back clearly.
* **Document everything** — capture daily logs, progress photos, and written field notes in Buildertrend so every project has an accurate, current record.
* Track subcontractor attendance and progress against the schedule; flag no-shows, delays, and slipping milestones to the PM immediately.
* Help coordinate subcontractor trades, material deliveries, and inspection scheduling under the PM’s direction.
* Confirm client-selected materials and finishes have arrived on site and match the project scope.
* Prepare job sites for inspections — verify access, cleanliness, and that required work is complete and ready.
* Follow up on punch-list and correction items, and confirm completion back to the PM.
* Run materials, documents, and equipment between job sites, suppliers, and the office as needed.
* Communicate professionally with homeowners on routine field matters; escalate anything sensitive or contractual to the PM.
* Learn IMKAT’s construction process, sequencing, and standards — take on increasing responsibility as skills develop.

**Experience**

* 2 years in construction, the trades, or a related field role - internships, labor, or trade experience all count.
* Exposure to residential construction job sites preferred, but a strong learner with the right drive will be considered.

**Technical Aptitude**

* Comfortable using a smartphone and software for documentation, photos, and communication; quick to pick up new tools like Buildertrend.

Pay: $29.00 - $33.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: On the road

* Experience in stakeholder management.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Program Manager for the AI and Gemini App Marketing team, you will be a key member of the Program Management team that acts as the operational engine connecting product and marketing strategy to seamless execution. In this role, your main objective is to equip marketers with the tools and processes to move with greater agility and velocity so together, you can seamlessly land launches and an ongoing drumbeat of marketing activity across Google’s top AI priorities. If you thrive in ambiguity, love building operational infrastructure (often from scratch), and want to shape how Google launches AI, this is your team.

You will support critical programs, including model go-to-market and tentpole moment enablement. Your role is truly cross-functional you will partner closely with Marketing leadership and connect the dots across PR, Product Areas like Chrome and Android, and Regions to bring our GTM strategy to life.

To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate possesses a track record in program management. You will support critical programs and short-term sprints, enabling rapid progress in a highly complex space. You are analytical and entrepreneurial, willing to try new things while managing numerous high-stakes projects with tight deadlines. You have a passion for AI and use AI tools to be more productive, saving time and enabling velocity. Things happen quickly at Google, and to do great work, you need to rapidly learn new context; quickly develop relationships across Marketing, Product, Comms and beyond; and produce meaningful results in highly ambiguous environments.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support end-to-end program management across critical cross-marketing initiatives, starting with early access/influencers, red teaming, and GTM enablement programs.
* Support multiple workstreams within a cross-functional program, proactively identifying, tracking, and mitigating risks.
* Act as the vanguard for the team’s AI transformation, transitioning manual, fragmented templates, tools and processes into automated, real-time ones.
* Act as a strategic bridge and escalation point across Product, Marketing, Legal, Comms, and Regional teams to eliminate silos.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. new_jobs.title: Richmond- ASP Program Leader
new_jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),

o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or

o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

***After School Program Dates***

* *San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027*

**Job Responsibilities**  
**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.

* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.

* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.

**Supervision & Safety**  
Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.  
Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline

**Record-Keeping & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation

**Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.

**Training & Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**  
The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

  

**The YMCA of Greater San Francisco is seeking Program Leaders at the following sites:**

* Richmond- Claire Lilienthal Elementary School
* Richmond- Jefferson Elementary School
* Richmond- Sutro Elementary School

Our practice emphasizes a confidential, long-term partnership between patient and surgeon, with highly personalized aesthetic care tailored to each individual’s goals. All surgical procedures are performed in a private, modern, fully accredited ambulatory surgical facility. Supported by an experienced and elite clinical team, the practice is dedicated to exceptional patient safety, comfort, and natural-looking results. Team members join a professional environment focused on high-quality care and a respectful, collaborative culture.

**Job Summary** This is a part-time position, with the ability to flex additional hours based on office operational needs. We are seeking a skilled, compassionate, and detail-oriented Experience and Patient Coordinator to join our elite team. In this hybrid role, you will serve as the primary touchpoint for our patients, combining high-touch luxury hospitality, seamless patient journey management, and proactive consultation coordination. You will guide patients from initial inquiry through their surgical and non-surgical journeys, ensuring an exceptional, white-glove experience while driving communication, scheduling, and conversion support.

**Duties**

* Manage inbound digital inquiries, phone calls, and social media leads with a prompt, calm, consultative approach in alignment with practice speed-to-lead standards.
* Conduct thorough patient consultations and pre-frame the patient journey to build emotional rapport, trust, and alignment with doctor recommendations.
* Coordinate patient schedules, streamline touchpoints from initial inquiry to post-operative follow-up, and handle booking logistics seamlessly.
* Guide patients through financial commitments, answer administrative questions with high emotional intelligence, and assist in addressing patient hesitations or objections ethically and effectively.
* Accompany doctors during clinical consultations when required to capture accurate, detailed notes and ensure a frictionless transition into the patient care pipeline.
* Maintain a pristine, organized, and luxury-standard front office and client environment, executing scheduled sensory and hospitality protocols.
* Partner cross-functional teams to support integrated marketing initiatives, social media engagement, content capture, and patient acquisition strategies.

**Requirements**

* Proven professional experience in luxury hospitality, premium retail, concierge medical environments, or aesthetic practice patient coordination.
* Exceptional customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills with a track record of building patient trust and driving conversion/retention.
* High emotional intelligence and strong problem-solving abilities to guide patients through medical and cosmetic decisions with empathy.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment while managing schedules, notes, and digital workflows.
* Collaborative mindset, willingness to cross-train across front office roles, and adaptability to practice-specific technology systems.

Join our team to deliver exceptional aesthetic care and high-touch service that enhances our clients’ confidence while advancing your career in a vibrant, beauty-focused environment!

Pay: $22.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 4.0 – 16.0 per week

Benefits:

* Free flu shots
* On-the-job training
* Opportunities for advancement

Ability to Commute:

* Mountain View, CA 94040 (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Bilingual Patient Experience & Treatment Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Are you someone who can make a complicated decision feel clear, comfortable, and manageable?

Sequoia Orthodontics is looking for a bilingual coordinator to guide patients and families from their initial consultation through financial arrangements, scheduling, and the start of treatment. You will work closely with the orthodontist and the rest of our team, combining patient relationships, organization, and practical problem-solving in a friendly, privately owned practice.

You do not need previous orthodontic experience to apply. Dental, healthcare, treatment-coordination, customer-service, hospitality, or patient-facing experience is helpful, but we are willing to train the right person. What matters most is that you communicate well, follow through, enjoy working with families, and are comfortable discussing schedules and financial options.

Professional fluency in both Spanish and English is required.

**What You’ll Do**

* Welcome patients and families and help them feel comfortable in our office
* Participate in new-patient consultations and help families understand their next steps
* Explain fees, insurance benefits, payment plans, and financial arrangements clearly
* Schedule treatment starts and coordinate the transition from consultation to active treatment
* Follow up with families who are considering treatment
* Verify insurance benefits and assist with insurance-related questions
* Collect payments and maintain accurate patient and financial information
* Coordinate appointments and assist with incoming calls and patient questions
* Communicate confidently with patients and parents in both Spanish and English
* Work closely with the orthodontist, clinical team, and front-office team
* Occasionally assist with patient events, community outreach, and practice-growth projects
* Help maintain an organized, upbeat, and welcoming office

**What We’re Looking For**

* Professional fluency in Spanish and English
* A warm, friendly, and confident communication style
* Comfort speaking with both children and adults
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through
* The ability to explain financial information in a clear and approachable way
* Reliability and the ability to manage several priorities in a busy office
* A collaborative attitude and genuine interest in helping patients
* Comfort learning new systems, workflows, and insurance processes

Experience in orthodontics, dentistry, healthcare, treatment coordination, scheduling, insurance, or patient-facing service is a plus, but it is not required.

If you think you would be a strong fit but do not check every box, we still encourage you to apply.

**What We Offer**

* $35–$40 per hour, depending on experience
* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401(k)
* Flexible Spending Account
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Employee orthodontic benefits
* Continuing education and on-the-job training
* Performance bonus opportunities
* A supportive team in a privately owned practice
* A friendly, patient-focused work environment

**Position Details**

* Full-time
* Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
* In-person position in San Mateo, California

If you are bilingual, enjoy helping people, and would like to grow with a close-knit orthodontic team, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: $35.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Uniform allowance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Patient Services Rep I
new_jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)**This is a Stanford Medicine Partners job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
Under general supervision, operates as part of the care team performing a variety of functions such as greeting patients, patient registration, insurance coverage and eligibility verification, scheduling and telephone management. The PSR I is an entry-level position with limited or no prior experience; under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team. For situations where the PSR is designated as a "trainee," the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Medicine Partners
  
  
**What you will do**

* C-I-CARE
* Executes world class practices of service and patient care in support of C-I-CARE standards.
* Uses C-I-CARE templates and the following components for all communication with patients and staff:
* CONNECT with people by calling them their proper name, or the name they prefer (Mr., Ms., Dr.)
* INTRODUCE yourself and your role
* COMMUNICATE what you are going to do, how long it will take, and how it will impact the patient
* ASK permission before entering a room, examining a patient or undertaking an activity
* RESPOND to patient’s questions or requests promptly; anticipate patient needs
* EXIT courteously with an explanation of what will come next
* Job Scope
* Performs routine support work and in a learning capacity, assists in but not limited to the following:
* Greets patients and others entering the department in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Registers new patients, schedule appointments and updates existing patient accounts in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Identifies accepted insurance plans and those requiring referrals, obtains and updates insurance information if necessary.
* Determines if patient has a co-payment or deposit; accepts and records receipt of payment; provides applicable waiver and obtains appropriate signature; and, when appropriate, scans copy of patient’s photo ID, insurance card, and/or waiver.
* Obtains applicable consent from patient.
* Resolves any system red flags as they are encountered.
* Responds to requests from patients, family members, physicians and staff in a courteous and professional manner in accordance with performance standards.
* Facilities communication between the patients and the physicians or clinic.
* Delivers basic knowledge regarding clinic-specific processes.
* Accurately documents and routes calls to the appropriate department(s).
* Manages flow of information received from various sources to appropriate staff member. May handle and deliver requests for approvals requiring signatures or input, lab reports, correspondence, dictations, and medical records.
* Communicates with clinical staff/providers through telephone encounters.
* Resolves registration discrepancies via assigned work queues.
* Balances cash sheet and cash drawer, completes daily deposit summary and prepares monthly deposit summary in accordance with performance standards.
* Delivers consistent high-level of customer service by using CI-Care principles.
* Meets all regulatory and compliance standards.
* Knowledge
* Learns to apply general knowledge through work assignments.
* Level of Supervision
* Works under general supervision and performs a variety of clerical and patient care duties to assist practitioners and other members of health care team.
* For situations where the PSR is designated as a “trainee,” the incumbent will work under close supervision, requiring mentor sign-off on certain activities.
* All other duties as assigned including department-specific functions and responsibilities:
* Performs other duties as assigned and participates in organization projects as assigned.
* Adheres to safety, P4P’s (if applicable), HIPAA and compliance policies.

  
**Education Qualifications**

* High school graduate or equivalent required.

  
**Experience Qualifications**

* One (1) year of customer service experience in a medical office, insurance, or client services environment required.
* Graduate of a Medical Receptionist training program, healthcare experience, or related preferred.
* EPIC experience preferred.

  
**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Strong verbal/written communication and listening skills; including excellent interpersonal skills and telephone communication.
* Ability to maintain composure during challenging interpersonal interactions.
* Legible handwriting.
* Basic math skills necessary to collect payments and balance cash drawer.
* Basic computer skills to include keyboarding, mouse movement and data entry skills to enter information into practice management system and EHR.
* Ability to effectively organize and prioritize tasks in order to complete assignments within the time allotted and maintain standard workflow.
* Ability to work with others in a flexible, cooperative manner.

  
**Physical Demands and Work Conditions**  
  
**Physical Demands**

* Constant Sitting.
* Occasional Walking.
* Occasional Standing.
* Frequent Bending.
* Occasional Squatting.
* Seldom Climbing.
* Occasional Kneeling.
* Seldom Crawling.
* Frequent Hand Use.
* Frequent Repetitive Motion Hand Use.
* Occasional Grasping.
* Occasional Fine Manipulation.
* Frequent Pushing and Pulling.
* Occasional Reaching (above shoulder level).
* Frequent Twisting and Turning (Neck and Waist).
* Constant Vision (Color, Peripheral, Distance, Focus).

**Lifting**

* Frequent lifting of 0 - 10 lbs.
* Frequent lifting of 11 - 20 lbs.
* Occasional lifting of 21 - 30 lbs.
* Occasional lifting of 31 - 40 l

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

**The job**
-----------

You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

You are our first dedicated post-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

*Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova is building a fast-growing clinical network for its personalised cancer vaccine programme. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. We run the whole process for patients and their oncologists, from initial review through treatment and follow-up.

**The role**

We're looking for a Patient Account Manager to own each patient's experience from sign-up through to administration and follow-up. You'll be the main point of contact for the patient, their family, their physician and, where separate, the treatment sponsor-investigator. You'll answer their questions and keep every step on track.

Success looks like an excellent experience for every patient in our care, and a patient journey that runs smoothly and on time.

**What you'll do**

* Guide new patients and families through sign-up, consent paperwork, records requests and what to expect at each stage
* Coordinate sample collection and shipping with the patient's physician, pathology labs and sequencing partners, and track each sample through to results and analysis
* Keep patients, families and physicians regularly updated on sequencing, manufacturing and administration dates
* Answer non-clinical questions yourself, and quickly pass clinical or medical questions to our nursing, medical or scientific team
* Keep accurate, confidential records of each patient's status, communications and outstanding actions
* Arrange practical support such as travel, scheduling and help with financial-access questions

**Your first few months**

* Get to know Serova's personalised cancer vaccine programme end to end, from both our side and the patient's
* Take over communication and day-to-day management of patients already on the programme
* Set up patient trackers and make sure every outstanding action and question is dealt with

**What we're looking for**

* Experience in a patient-facing coordination role, such as patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support, ideally in oncology. If you've done similar work outside a clinical setting and have the right mindset, we'd still like to hear from you.
* A track record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across several external parties, such as clinics, labs and couriers
* Clear, compassionate communication with patients and families during a difficult time, and confidence working with physicians and their teams
* Careful handling of confidential health information, with working knowledge of HIPAA
* Good judgement about which questions to answer yourself and which to escalate to clinical colleagues

**Nice to have**

* Experience with personalised or autologous therapy programmes
* Specimen chain of custody
* Expanded-access or clinical-trial enrolment
* Patient CRM or case-management systems
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP)

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco, California
* **Type:** Full-time
* **Salary:** $100,000 to $130,000

Questions? Email clinical@serova.bio

new_jobs.title: Case Manager II - Utilization Management
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.  
  
**Job ID:** P140091-2660347

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Case Managers are licensed nursing professionals responsible for coordinating continuum of care and discharge planning activities for a caseload of assigned patients. Major responsibilities include coordinating all facets of a patient's admission/discharge; performing utilization review activities, including review of patient charts for timeliness of services as well as appropriate utilization of services; and ensuring optimum use of resources, service delivery, and compliance with external review agencies' requirements. Case Managers act as consultants to the clinical team, service lines, and other departments regarding patient assessment and patient care and participate in program development and quality improvement initiatives. In their role, Case Managers, by applying guidelines and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, influence and direct the delivery and quality of patient care. A hospital-based case management system has as its primary goal to ensure the most appropriate use of services by patients and, toward that end, to avoid duplication and misuse of medical services, control costs by reducing inefficient services, and improve the effectiveness of care delivery. Objectives are to facilitate timely discharge; prompt, efficient use of resources; achievement of expected outcomes; collaborative practice; coordination of care across the continuum; and performance/quality improvement activities that lead to optimal patient outcomes. A Case Manager differs from other roles in professional nursing/health care practice in that it is not intended to provide direct patient care; rather, a Case Manager will be assigned to specific patients to ensure that the medical services and treatments required are accomplished in the most financially and clinically efficient manner.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

COORDINATION OF CARE

* Manages each patient's transition through the system and transfers accountability to the appropriate person upon entry into another clinical service or discharge.

DISCHARGE PLANNING

* Coordinates and facilitates timely implementation of discharge plans for assigned patients with complex needs in collaboration with other interdisciplinary team members; arranges follow-up care as appropriate.

EDUCATION/CONSULTATION

* Acts as an educational resource and provides consultation to patients and their families, hospital medical personnel regarding the discharge planning process and applicable regulatory requirements; educates the staff on case management; and provides specific information related to case types.

LEAD WORK

OTHER

new_jobs.title: E-Commerce Order Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
E-Commerce Customer Service & Order Operations Specialist  
TikTok Live-Commerce Jewelry Business  
On-Site | San Francisco, California  
$25–$32 per hour | Part-Time or Full-Time

About the Role

We are a fast-growing jewelry company selling through high-volume TikTok LIVE auctions. We are looking for a reliable, highly organized person to take ownership of daily customer-service and post-sale operations.

This person will help ensure that customer questions are answered promptly, returns and refunds are handled properly, orders are processed accurately, and packaging or fulfillment problems are identified before they affect customers.

The position requires someone who is comfortable switching between customer communication, computer-based administrative work, and hands-on order checking. As our business grows, this person will also help us improve and develop practical procedures for managing customer service, returns, order accuracy, and other after-sales issues.

Responsibilities

· Manage daily customer-service messages and resolve customer concerns promptly and professionally.

· Review and handle refund and return requests using good judgment and available order information.

· Inspect returned merchandise and help resolve discrepancies.

· Print and organize customer orders following livestreams.

· Monitor after-sales issues, including missing, damaged, delayed, or incorrect items.

· Help maintain packaging and order accuracy.

· Perform spot checks of completed orders and product trays to identify possible mistakes before shipment.

· Use order records, livestream information, and video receipts when researching discrepancies.

· Monitor negative reviews and assist with appropriate responses and resolutions.

· Keep clear and organized records of customer issues, returns, refunds, and unresolved cases.

· Communicate problems and recurring patterns to management.

· Coordinate with livestream, packaging, shipping, and warehouse employees.

· Help develop more effective procedures as order volume increases.

· Take on other related e-commerce and operational responsibilities as needed.

Qualifications

· Experience in customer service, e-commerce, order processing, returns, fulfillment, quality control, or a similar role is preferred.

· Excellent attention to detail and the ability to notice small discrepancies.

· Strong organizational and time-management skills.

· Good judgment when evaluating customer complaints, refunds, and returns.

· Strong written communication skills and a professional manner with customers.

· Comfortable working with computers, spreadsheets, order systems, and online selling platforms.

· Able to investigate a problem, identify the likely cause, and follow it through to resolution.

· Able to work efficiently in a high-volume and fast-changing environment.

· Comfortable performing both administrative work and hands-on order checking.

· Dependable, responsible, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

· Willing to take initiative and help improve systems that are still being developed.

· Experience with TikTok Shop, livestream selling, jewelry, online marketplaces, or high-volume consumer orders is helpful but not required.

· No specific college degree is required.

Ideal Candidate

The right person is careful, practical, and accountable. You do not assume that an order or customer issue has been handled correctly—you verify it. You can recognize when something looks wrong, investigate the situation, and communicate clearly with the appropriate people.

You should also be comfortable joining a growing company where not every procedure has already been established. We want someone who can learn our business, handle current responsibilities reliably, and help us create better processes over time.

Schedule

This position may be part-time or full-time, depending on the candidate’s experience and availability. Some schedule flexibility may be needed to support our livestream and order-processing schedule, including occasional evenings or weekends.

This is an on-site position in San Francisco.

Compensation

$25–$32 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

How to Apply

Please submit your résumé and briefly answer the following questions:

1. What relevant experience do you have with customer service, e-commerce, refunds, returns, order processing, or quality control?

2. Describe a situation in which you identified and resolved an order, inventory, or customer-service problem.

3. How do you stay accurate when working quickly or handling repetitive, high-volume tasks?

4. Are you looking for part-time or full-time work?

5. Are you available to work on-site in San Francisco?

Pay: $25.00 - $32.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person
