new_jobs.title: Direct Sales Enablement Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Cleaned Document
  
**About the role and team**  
  
Sales Enablement at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. In this role, you will be the primary architect of the skills, knowledge, and processes that empower our sales teams to move the real world. You aren't just delivering training; you are building the foundation for a high-performing commercial engine that operates at a massive, global scale across fast-evolving business lines like Uber Eats, Uber for Business, and our incubation ventures.
  
  
You will lead high-leverage programs in an environment where change is constant and the stakes are high. This requires a leader who can move fluidly between high-level strategy and hands-on implementation, bridging the gap between complex product roadmaps and real-world sales execution. If you lead with clarity, thrive in challenge, and are motivated by the measurable impact of learning on business growth, this is where you'll make your mark.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own the end-to-end design and execution of sales enablement roadmaps, including new hire onboarding, continuing education, and commercial skill certification.
* Diagnose systemic sales productivity gaps using data-driven insights from Salesforce and conversational intelligence tools to design repeatable, performance-improving playbooks.
* Navigate cross-functional complexity by partnering with Sales, Ops, and Product teams to align enablement priorities with regional business goals and global strategies.
* Orchestrate organizational change by leading the rollout of new sales methodologies, tech stack optimizations, and product launches to a diverse, global sales force.
* Champion a "learner-first" culture, delivering engaging in-person and virtual training sessions that simplify the complex and drive measurable, lasting behavioral change.
* Communicate with purpose to senior leadership, synthesizing program impact and sales performance metrics into clear narratives and strategic recommendations.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, or Sales Operations.
* Proven track record in customer-facing sales roles or coaching frontline sales staff in a high-growth B2B tech environment.
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering comprehensive training programs, including onboarding and skill-development playbooks.
* Proficiency in sales enablement technologies (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Highspot) and building reporting from CRM data.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-workstream projects with tight deadlines.
* Exceptional presentation and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design for diverse audiences.
* Experience working in high-intensity startups or tech environments where priorities evolve rapidly.
* Mastery of stakeholder management, with the ability to build trust-based relationships across global time zones.
* Professional fluency in additional regional languages (e.g., Spanish, German, or Portuguese) where applicable.
* Experience leading sales events, offsites, or Sales Kickoff (SKO) planning.
Graduate degree or equivalent certification in Project Management (PMP) or Change Management.  

  
  
For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $113,000 per year - USD $126,000 per year.  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $126,000 per year - USD $140,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $126,000 per year - USD $140,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

new_jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist
new_jobs.description:
The Learning & Development (L&D) Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and continuously improving learning programs that support associate growth, organizational effectiveness, and business objectives. This role owns the company's onboarding experience, collaborates with stakeholders to identify learning needs, develops engaging learning solutions, and manages programs from conception through evaluation.

The Learning & Development Specialist combines expertise in instructional design, program management, organizational development, and learning administration with a passion for creating impactful associate development experiences.

**Onboarding Program Management**

* Own and continuously enhance the end-to-end associate onboarding experience for new hires.
* Partner with HR, business leaders, and subject matter experts to ensure onboarding content remains current and aligned with business priorities.
* Manage onboarding schedules, communications, learning assignments, and program logistics.
* Evaluate onboarding effectiveness through feedback, participation metrics, and business outcomes, implementing improvements as needed.

**Learning Program Design & Development**

* Design, create, update, and maintain high-quality presentations, guides, videos, e-learning modules, facilitator materials, participant resources, job aids, and quick-reference tools.
* Translate complex information into practical, accessible, learner-centered content aligned with adult-learning principles, organizational standards, and Fremont Bank branding.
* Organize and maintain learning resources within the Learning Management System and approved shared-learning platforms.
* Support virtual, hybrid, and in-person learning delivery and troubleshoot routine learning-technology issues.
* Use approved AI-assisted content tools responsibly, validating accuracy, protecting confidential information, complying with licensing requirements, and applying appropriate human review.

**Organizational Development Support**

* Support organizational development initiatives that strengthen associate engagement, leadership capability, career development, talent readiness, and organizational effectiveness.
* Assist in the implementation of talent development programs and change management efforts.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to support a culture of continuous learning and growth.

**Program Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Manage multiple learning and development programs simultaneously, ensuring successful planning, execution, and delivery.
* Develop project plans, timelines, communication strategies, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate resources, stakeholders, facilitators, and vendors to ensure program success.
* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate program effectiveness and impact.
* Recommend and implement enhancements based on data, stakeholder input, and best practices.

**Learning Administration**

* Maintain learning records, program documentation, and learning management system (LMS) data.
* Manage course enrollment, program communications, training calendars, and reporting.
* Ensure training materials and learning resources remain accurate and accessible.
* Support compliance and audit-related training requirements as needed.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with external training providers, consultants, and learning partners.
* Assist with vendor selection, scheduling, contracting, invoicing, and program delivery.
* Evaluate vendor performance and learning outcomes to ensure quality and alignment with organizational needs.

**Learning & Development Support**

* Serve as a trusted partner to associates, managers, and HR colleagues regarding learning and development resources.
* Stay informed on emerging L&D trends, technologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of the organization's learning strategy and associate development initiatives.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Education, Business, Psychology, or related field.
* 3 plus years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related function.
* Experience managing onboarding programs and employee development initiatives.
* Experience designing and delivering training content using instructional design methodologies.
* Experience managing projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of adult learning theory and instructional design models (ADDIE, SAM, or similar).
* Experience with learning management systems (LMS) and virtual learning platforms.
* Familiarity with organizational development and talent management practices.
* Training, facilitation, or coaching certification preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical requirements described below are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods (e.g., sitting or standing).
* Frequent use of a computer and other office equipment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and customers.
* Occasionally move or lift items up to 10 pounds.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

new_jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is the global leader in Lean AI supply chains. By bringing together expert people, industry-leading technology, and a disciplined operating model, we take on some of the toughest supply chain challenges and continuously improve how we deliver for our customers.

We’re seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the integration of acquired businesses into our global enterprise. In this highly visible role, you’ll bring structure to complex integrations, aligning teams across the business to turn strategy into action, navigate change, and deliver lasting business value.

You’ll serve as a central point of coordination, building and executing integration plans, anticipating challenges, and continuously improving how we work. Along the way, you’ll partner with experts across the business, take on real responsibility, and help shape how we build what’s next at C.H. Robinson.

*At C.H. Robinson, we believe collaboration plays an important role in how we solve complex problems and drive meaningful results. For this role, we have a preference for candidates located near our Eden Prairie, MN, or Chicago, IL offices, where there are opportunities for in-person connection and collaboration. However, we’re open to fully remote candidates and will prioritize finding the right person for the role.*

**Responsibilities:**
=====================

The duties and responsibilities of this position consists of, but are not limited to, the following:

* Lead multiple, large-scale, and complex integration projects, translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and driving execution across cross-functional teams
* Own critical project documentation, including project charters, plans, process flows and value stream maps, resource requirements, and business cases
* Bring together internal and external stakeholders around shared priorities, deliverables, dependencies, and decisions, building trust through clear and consistent communication
* Drive projects forward to deliver quality solutions on time and within budget, taking ownership of outcomes, proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and escalating when appropriate
* Lead teams through change by influencing without direct authority, welcoming different perspectives, and constructively challenging the status quo to achieve stronger outcomes
* Track, manage, and communicate project progress and financial performance, including resource requirements, budget-to-actual performance, key milestones, and project outcomes
* Apply a continuous improvement and builder mindset to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and strengthen the tools, processes, and ways of working that support successful integrations

* Partner with experts across the business to transfer knowledge, strengthen organizational capabilities, and mentor project team members
* Lead Robinson Operating Model (ROM) projects internally to advance our lean operating model

**Required Qualifications:**
============================

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
* Minimum 5 years of project management experience, with the proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to work flexible hours (some weekend/late hours may be required)

**Preferred Qualifications:**
=============================

* Project Management Professional certification
* Work and/or project experience in Supply Chain, Transportation, and/or Logistics
* Strong communication skills: strong listener with exceptional facilitation skills and the ability to tell the story and connect to your audience
* Ability to organize, design, develop, and deliver projects for internal and external audiences at all levels
* Ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts internally and externally at all levels
* Experience working and thriving in a continuous improvement environment
* Experience and comfort in dealing with ambiguity and able to deliver with minimal oversight
* Experience working directly with customers
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs
* Experience with lean processes and tools
* Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Compensation Range**

$77,000.00 - $173,600.00

The base pay range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for the position across all U.S. locations. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only and do not include additional variable compensation.

Questioning if you meet the mark? Studies have shown that some individuals may be less likely to apply unless they match the job description exactly. Here at C.H. Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

**Equal Opportunity**

new_jobs.title: Manager, Product Operations & UX
new_jobs.description:
Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery.
  
  
Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts. Product Operations is how product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. AI enablement is how we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. UX is product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. Together they are the backbone that lets empowered teams move fast without losing quality.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product.

What you’ll own

* **Operating model and cadence.** Own how product is built and run: the product development lifecycle, the operating rhythm of planning, reviews, and metrics, and portfolio operations across teams.
* **Program management.** Own program and release management — keeping cross-team initiatives on track and dependencies, risks, and progress visible to leadership.
* **Tooling and data.** Own the product toolchain and the portfolio data and metrics, so teams and leaders share one trustworthy view of how we are doing.
* AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. Own how AI is applied to the lifecycle itself — compressing the path from opportunity to validated, scoped work; standing up business cases with AI-assisted sizing and evidence; and sharpening portfolio prioritization.
* **Design and research (UX).** Lead product design, user research, and the design system — partnering with product and engineering from discovery through launch.

What you’ll do

* Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works.
* Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work.
* Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible.
* Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes.
* Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk.
* Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth.
* Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products.
* Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early.
* Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design.

What you bring

* 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models.
* Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization.
* Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track.
* Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system.
* Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth.
* People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives.

Nice to have

* Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain.
* Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment.
* Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development.

**Compensation**

The actual salary offered may vary based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific requirements of the role. This range may also be subject to change as market conditions evolve. We encourage open communication throughout the interview process to discuss compensation expectations. For base-salary + commission sales roles, the range represents On-Target Earnings.

**ABOUT WIPA**

The Wedding Industry Professionals Association (WIPA) is a national nonprofit association for wedding and event professionals, with chapters across the United States. Our members are business owners and practitioners who join for education, connection and credibility in their industry. Our chapters are run by volunteer boards who give their time on top of running their own businesses.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

This is one of the first three staff positions in WIPA's history.

WIPA is bringing its management in-house, moving onto a new association management platform, and building its operations from the ground up. The Operations Manager is the person who makes all of that hold together — and who gets to design it rather than maintain someone else's version of it.

This is the seat that keeps the record straight. Board minutes and packets. The data behind every number the association reports. Event registration and logistics. The document libraries, workflows and automation that mean WIPA's institutional knowledge lives in a system rather than in one person's head.

It is also the seat where good systems thinking shows up fastest. You will be asked what should be automated, and then given room to build it.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Keep the numbers true.** Maintain the accuracy of association data and produce monthly reporting on membership, retention, renewals and activity, reconciled to written definitions. Discrepancies should be found here first.
* **Support member retention from the back office.** Produce a weekly list of members expiring in the next 30, 60 and 90 days for the Senior Relationship Manager, and report each month which scheduled reminders and automations actually went out. The shared standard across both roles: no expiring member goes uncontacted.
* **Build the automation layer.** Design and maintain the connections between the association's database, workspace, accounting and communications tools. new_jobs.title: Instructional Designer (Contract)
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE WORK**
------------------

Alchemy designs and builds online courses for universities and workforce education providers. You would work on a per-course basis alongside a faculty subject matter expert, taking a course from the first conversation through to a finished build the client signs off on.

Engagements are contracted per course, so you can take one course or several depending on your capacity. Most courses run eight to fourteen weeks of development.

This is a collaborative role. You will work directly with your SME on a regular cadence, and there are project and client calls from time to time. If you are looking for work that can be done entirely asynchronously with no contact with faculty or the client, this is not that role.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

**Design and development**

Partner with a faculty subject matter expert to develop the course plan: learning outcomes, assessment map, and the overall shape of the course.

Write the course guide or blueprint, the document that contains everything that will be built in the LMS. This includes instructional narrative, activity and assessment design, rubrics where used, and links to resources.

Review and write learning outcomes using Bloom's Taxonomy and related frameworks, making sure they are stated in performance terms, pitched to the audience, and sequenced to match the course design.

Design formative and summative assessments, knowledge checks and learning activities that actually measure the outcomes.

Draft a media plan with the SME, specifying what each asset is for, which outcome it addresses and roughly how long it should be, then work with media producers and interactive developers to get it made.

Work to the client's templates, style guide, terminology and design standards, which differ by client and which we will give you at kickoff.

Hold the standards: accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), the client's style guide, and the design standards for the project. Remediating accessibility issues in your own deliverables is part of the work.

**Meetings and collaboration**

Hold regular working sessions with your subject matter expert through the design phase. Plan on a standing weekly meeting. The course gets designed in those conversations, and a designer who only emails the SME will not get what the course needs.

Attend additional project and client calls as necessary, or as your contract stipulates.

**Project administration**

Keep your own task status current in the client's project system (usually ClickUp). The project manager owns the schedule, but nobody can run a schedule off tasks that are not updated.

Run the review and approval process for your courses: submit on the dates in the plan, use the client's review request form, and route it to the named reviewers.

Review the built course in the LMS against your approved blueprint, log what needs fixing in one place, confirm the fixes landed, and sign off before it goes to the client.

Raise problems early. If a date is going to slip, an SME has gone quiet, or the scope has crept, say so while it can still be managed.

**HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS**
----------------------------

Contracted per course under a work for hire agreement. Deliverables are owned by the client.

Paid a fixed fee per course at defined milestones, on acceptance of each deliverable. This is not hourly work and there is no timesheet.

A defined number of review cycles is included in the fee. The cycle count, the turnaround time we expect from you, and the revision window are stated in your contract.

Revisions requested inside that window are included. Work beyond it, or a change to the course scope after sign off, is handled as a contract amendment before it is started, not after.

Course assignments can change. Courses get added, removed, delayed or reassigned by the client. When that happens we amend the contract rather than absorbing it quietly.

You will work in our systems and the client's: Google Workspace, Slack, the project system, and the client's LMS. Some clients provide guest access with rules attached, and we will tell you what those are.

We use AI tooling in our process, including our own platform. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to be comfortable working alongside it and following our rules about what client content can and cannot be put into external tools.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**
-----------------------

Experience designing courses in higher education, K-12 or workforce learning and development, with at least one full course taken from outline to delivery.

Fluency with learning management systems, Canvas and Brightspace in particular.

The ability to work with a faculty subject matter expert who is an expert in their field but not in course design, and to lead that relationship without taking it over.

Comfort in client-facing conversations, including ones where you have to say no or explain why something will not work.

Clear, structured writing and the discipline to follow a style guide and a template rather than your own preferred format.

The self-management to hit dates in a distributed team without being chased.

A degree in education, instructional design, instructional technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Candor about what you have not done. We would much rather know at the application stage that you have never built an interactive or never worked in Brightspace than find out when it blocks a deliverable.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

Experience with Articulate Storyline or Rise, H5P, or other interactive development tools.

Familiarity with Quality Matters or similar course design standards.

Experience picking up a partially built course from another designer and finishing it.

Experience using AI tools as part of a design workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not.

Experience in a specific discipline area: business, criminal justice, education, psychology, healt
